title: Electronic Payment Processing Implementation Specialist
description:
Electronic Payment Processing Implementation Specialist

Customer Intelligence Inc. is a professional consulting service and marketing firm, providing cutting-edge services to help customers grow. CI specializes in the financial industry and works with clients across multiple industries, payment brands, processing systems, and other enterprises with a focus on LATAM.

PROFILING

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as Business, Computer Science, or Engineering , with a Master's degree being an added advantage.

EXPERIENCE

The ideal candidate for this role should possess the following experience and skills:

  • +3 years of experience in project management and technical implementation knowledge preferable (not obligatory) in the electronic payments industry , with a focus on customer processing implementation projects
  • Relevant experience in “Information Technology” system knowledge, with strong understanding of network technology, applications, and project management.
  • Strong payment transaction processing and industry business principles knowledge.
  • Strong understanding of electronic payment processing systems, formats and associated customer host interface testing services and principles.
  • Ability to interact well with the customer, Sr. and Executive management.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with ability to leverage these skills in a teaching environment.
  • Ability to drive change in a technical work environment.
  • Ability to lead matrix organizations and cross-functional teams.
  • Self-Starter with ability to work independently.
  • API Knowledge for Java and open languages.
  • Relevant experience on Computing Network services.
  • Development systems methodologies knowledge.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish languages.
  • Are you motivated to be a part of driving a world beyond cash?
  • Have you good knowledge about electronic payment and related processes such as authorization, clearing and settlement?
  • Are you able to cope with a fast-changing and ambiguous environment?

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are looking for an implementation specialist with good technical knowledge, preferably in the Electronic Payments industry to oversee the implementation of electronic payments processing business activities for customers. Responsibilities include project management, customer needs assessment, system impact analysis, customer testing, advising customers' processing support staff, ensuring implementation quality and reliability, and compliance with product rules and specifications.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • In a customer-facing environment, lead a cross-functional processing implementation project team of technical and non-technical electronic payment processing experts from the industry.
  • Deliver standard through complex implementation activities ensuring quality and reliability of the implementations.
  • Act as central point of contact for customers representatives throughout processing implementation project end-to-end execution.
  • Assess and document customer needs and according implementation impacts on customers’ core and non-core processing systems and platforms.
  • Define scope, plan and drive customer processing implementation projects of new electronic payments processing business activities following the global project coordination methodology.
  • Act as processing implementation advisor, to customers’ processing support staff. Provide guidance to execute all necessary processing implementation activities.
  • Execute extensive and comprehensive initial end-to-end processing system impact analyses for multiple key customer processing implementation projects in parallel.
  • Assure processing interfaces with electronic payment processing systems are compliant with global product rules, specifications, achieving KPIs and SLAs.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

  • A result-driven approach, groomed in all our associates, as long as all commitments with clients, internal and external to the firm, are accomplished.
  • An exciting and professional work environment.
  • A competitive compensation package.
  • Exposure to key decision makers in the industry in Latin America Continuous knowledge building initiatives to support your career growth.
  • A temporary contract with HIGH POSSIBILITY OF RENEWAL.

English Teacher for Trainee Missionaries in Brazil (July)

If you enjoy teaching English, spend a summer holiday blessing young Brazilian Christians eager to learn English, preparing them for cross-cultural mission.

WEC's EFM (English For Mission) programme is an intensive 2-week English language course (this July) run at WEC's headquarters in Belo Horizonte that will focus on Christian and mission vocabulary.

Your adult students will be church members, Bible school students, trainee missionaries, and church leaders. Teach three classes of around 8-10 students at three levels: basic, intermediate, and advanced.

You will come one week before classes begin to prepare and will be able to stay on an extra week for cultural experience and sightseeing or opportunity to pick up some Portuguese.

It is an occupational requirement of any role with WEC International to have a committed evangelical Christian faith, because sharing your faith will be part of that role.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Quer entrar ou migrar para o mercado financeiro, ajudando pessoas a alcançar seus objetivos de vida? Esta é a sua oportunidade, #SejaRaiz!

SOBRE A BRAÚNA

Fundada em 2015, a Braúna surgiu do sonho de profissionais com extensa experiência no mercado financeiro de criar uma empresa com um serviço diferenciado na maneira do cliente investir. Com alinhamento de interesses e visão de longo prazo, nosso objetivo é oferecer o melhor serviço, os melhores produtos e criar o mais completo e eficiente ecossistema de negócios do Brasil, com soluções para o mercado nacional e internacional. Deste sonho, temos acima de R$9 bilhões sob custódia e mais de 200 sócios alinhados com o ideal “Cliente em Primeiro Lugar”.

RESPONSABILIDADE E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Programa Seja Raiz:

O Seja Raiz é um programa de 6 meses, dividido em 2 fases, onde o/a trainee se desenvolverá para se especializar na área de maior sinergia.

1º Fase (3 meses):

  • Treinamentos comerciais para qualificação no atendimento a clientes.
  • Treinamentos técnicos sobre diversos produtos financeiros: investimentos, seguros de vida, consórcio, financiamento, planejamento financeiro pessoal, créditos, produtos PJs, câmbio, entre outros.
  • Responsabilidades:
    • Prospecção de clientes;
    • Mapeamento e estruturação da carteira de clientes;
    • Desenvolvimento de estratégias financeiras adequadas ao perfil dos clientes;
    • Apresentação de soluções financeiras;
    • Construção de relacionamento com os clientes;
    • Atualização sobre tendências do mercado financeiro

2º Fase (3 meses):

  • Avaliações para tomada de decisão para qual área o/a trainee tem maior sinergia: assessoria de investimentos, planejamento financeiro, aquisição de bens, planejamento patrimonial, áreas operacionais ou especialização em produtos financeiros específicos (renda variável, fixa, câmbio, FIIs, etc).
  • Treinamentos específicos para se tornar um especialista na área escolhida.

3º Fase:

  • Conclusão dos 6 meses com formatura.
  • Avaliações de desempenho e comportamental.
  • Início da jornada na Braúna em uma nova área.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Interesse na área comercial;
  • Ensino superior completo ou no último ano (qualquer área);
  • Morar em Campinas ou região;
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpesssoal;
  • Diferenciais: Experiência no mercado financeiro e certificações (CPA-10/ CPA-20/ CEA/ CFP);
  • Gostar de desafios.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

  • Programa de incentivos financeiros;
  • Acesso a plataformas de capacitação exclusivas da Braúna;
  • Possibilidade de acesso ao Total Pass.

E você? Gostou da ideia? Se inscreva em nosso processo seletivo para te conhecermos melhor. #VemSerBraúna ?

ART

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

title: Como Associado ou Consultor Associado
description:
Sobre a Charles River Associates:

A Charles River Associates tem sido, há mais de 50 anos, uma empresa pioneira de consultoria que oferece aos funcionários um lugar para colaborar e aprender com um grupo diversificado de consultores, especialistas do setor e acadêmicos. Na CRA, você se juntará a mentes líderes que usam análises econômicas, financeiras, técnicas e de negócios para resolver problemas complexos para uma lista impressionante de clientes, incluindo 99% dos 100 maiores escritórios de advocacia, 89% das empresas da Fortune 100 e agências governamentais em todo o mundo. A CRA oferece um ambiente colaborativo, com equipes que buscam a excelência do cliente, trazendo curiosidade, desenvoltura e iniciativa ao seu trabalho. Através de um ambiente colegiado, oportunidades formais e informais de treinamento e uma ampla gama de recursos de desenvolvimento profissional, sua experiência na CRA abrirá portas para você à medida que você acelera sua carreira.

Visão geral do trabalho

Como Associado ou Consultor Associado, você apoiará a equipe sênior na realização de avaliações de risco de Compliance, investigações contábeis forenses, pesquisa e análise de grande volume de dados. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com colegas no Brasil, nos Estados Unidos e na Europa, mas será fundamentalmente responsável pelo trabalho executado pela companhia do Brasil.

Você será responsável por trabalhar em atribuições de pesquisa, investigações financeiras, litígios e questões de disputa. As responsabilidades podem incluir (mas não se limitam a):

  • Investigar e analisar registros financeiros e contábeis em apoio a diversas investigações financeiras, como apropriação indébita de ativos, corrupção ou fraude nas demonstrações financeiras.
  • Realizar procedimentos contábeis forenses como parte de grandes investigações multidisciplinares que incorporam investigações tradicionais de pesquisas de antecedentes, conjuntos de dados complexos e análises técnicas contábeis ou econômicas.
  • Utilizar históricos econômico, contábil e/ou financeiro para apoiar especialistas seniores.
  • Preparar e apresentar materiais em relação às propostas e reuniões dos clientes.
  • Participar de iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios e desenvolvimento de práticas.

About the role

We are seeking a skilled and go-getter Sr. Machine Learning Engineer to join our Data Science team and play a pivotal role in driving the model development/production lifecycle. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with Data Scientists, MLOps, and DataOps teams to implement ML models for assessing transactional risk and fraud, enable automated model retraining, and support robust machine learning inference systems. This role is essential for ensuring efficient, reliable, and scalable workflows to power data-driven insights and machine learning solutions.


What you will do:

  • Model Development and Optimization: Design the data-architecture flow for the efficient implementation of real-time model endpoints and/or batch solutions.
  • Data Exploration and Feature Engineering: Engineer domain-specific features that can enhance model performance and robustness.
  • Productionization of ML Models: Build pipelines to deploy machine learning models in production with a focus on scalability and efficiency, and participate in and enforce the release management process for models and rules.
  • Monitoring, Maintenance & Improvement: Implement systems to monitor model performance, endpoints/feature health, and other business metrics; Create model-retraining pipelines to boost performance, based on monitoring metrics; Model recalibration.
  • Scalable System Design: Design and implement scalable architectures to support real-time/batch solutions; Optimize algorithms and workflows for latency, throughput, and resource efficiency; Ensure systems adhere to company standards for reliability and security.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Conduct research and prototypes to explore novel approaches in ML engineering for addressing emerging risk/fraud patterns.
  • Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with fraud analysts, risk managers, and product teams to translate business requirements into ML solutions.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in CS/Engineering/Data-Science or other technical disciplines.
  • Solid experience in DS/ML engineering.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Hands-on experience in implementing batch and real-time streaming pipelines, using SQL and NoSQL database solutions.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools for data pipelines, streaming systems, and model performance.
  • Experience in AWS cloud services (Sagemaker, EC2, EMR, ECS/EKS, RDS, etc.).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation), and MLOps platforms like MLflow.
  • Experience with Machine Learning modeling, notably tree-based and boosting models supervised learning for imbalanced target scenarios.
  • Experience with Online Inference, APIs, and services that respond under tight time constraints.
  • Proficiency in English.

    • Prior experience with AWS Sagemaker and/or similar DS/ML workbench.
    • Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
    • Feature store development and integration experience.
    • Experience with distributed data systems such as Kafka, Spark, Hadoop, and workflow/data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow).

title: Account Manager, Global Selling DSR (Direct Seller Recruiting), Amazon Global Selling
description:
Account Manager, Global Selling DSR (Direct Seller Recruiting), Amazon Global Selling

Are you looking for a challenging career in business-development? Do you have prior experience and a proven track-record in delivering against targets in a fast-paced, dynamic environment? Amazon is looking for a Global Selling Account Managers to join its team based in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
Your role will be focused on contributing to new business acquisition (50% of the time) through hunting, specifically phone/email-based prospecting of new merchants who can bring their competitive range of products, pricing and availability to Amazon. You will also work with merchants as an account manager (50% of the time) – helping them to launch and grow their business on Amazon by ensuring they understand Amazon’s products, services, systems and tools. Lastly you will be responsible for using feedback from the merchants to identify opportunities to improve Amazon’s products, services, processes, systems and tools.
Key job responsibilities
- Identify, prospect and recruit high-potential merchants via phone or email
- Effectively prioritize and manage a pipeline of merchants to consistently meet/exceed quarterly targets
- Be a business partner for new merchants providing them with data-driven insights and advice to optimize their success on Amazon
- Work closely with new merchants, educating them about Amazon’s high standards of Delivery and Customer Experience
- Enable merchants to learn and master Amazon's tools and systems so they may become self-sufficient in managing their catalog, inventory and performance efficiently and to the required standards
- Learn and understand the specificities of your categories to spot trends, seasonal items and competitive pricing to best tailor your pitch and advice to merchants
- Track and report business development results, analyze, interpret reports and information for your portfolio of merchants
- Prioritize your time optimally to achieve your targets in a KPI-driven environment
A day in the life
A typical day begins with reviewing performance metrics and pipeline status before diving into proactive outreach to potential merchants. Throughout the morning, you'll conduct virtual meetings with new sellers, providing comprehensive onboarding support and guidance through Amazon's Seller Central platform. The afternoon focuses on analyzing merchant data, conducting business reviews, and offering strategic recommendations for growth. You'll continuously monitor category trends, evaluate competitive pricing, and ensure merchants maintain Amazon's high standards for delivery and customer experience. The day involves balancing reactive support with proactive business development, all while tracking progress against quarterly targets and updating necessary reports in the CRM system. Participation in external events may apply.
About the team
Our dynamic, multicultural team is dedicated to expanding Amazon's global marketplace by enabling merchants worldwide to reach international customers. Operating at the intersection of technology and international commerce, we help businesses navigate multiple marketplaces, local regulations, and cultural nuances. Our team combines diverse perspectives from professionals across different regions and languages, working together to break down cross-border selling barriers. We pride ourselves on our data-driven approach, entrepreneurial spirit, and commitment to merchant success. Join us in shaping the future of global e-commerce while maintaining Amazon's customer-centric focus.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience prospecting, qualifying, and cold-calling companies
- Experience in procurement, negotiation, sales, consulting, supply chain, product/project management, or marketing
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with pipeline management skills to include utilization of Salesforce or other CRM tools
- Experience and track record of exceeding sales goals
- Experience within e-commerce or Retail fields

Nossa declaração de Diversidade Equidade & Inclusão

Na JDE Peet's, nosso propósito é criar um futuro melhor, no qual servimos, refletimos e abraçamos todos em suas autenticidades. Acreditamos na promoção de uma organização mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva, em que todos se sintam confortáveis para serem, verdadeiramente, quem são e possam despertar todo o seu potencial. Isto significa que não toleramos qualquer tipo de discriminação com base em raça ou etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica diversa e protegida por lei.

Ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos associados, priorizamos DE&I no centro dos nossos processos de pessoas. Isso nos permite promover o respeito e eliminar qualquer preconceito ou ação discriminatória, garantindo uma experiência inclusiva no ambiente de trabalho. Não hesite em entrar em contato se precisar de qualquer suporte durante o processo de recrutamento.

Quem somos nós?

A JDE Peet’s é uma empresa líder mundial especializada em cafés e chás, sediada na Holanda e com uma história que começou em 1753. Despertamos possibilidades de café e chá em mais de 100 países com um portfólio de mais de 50 marcas.

No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional com liderança absoluta em São Paulo e no Rio de Janeiro, através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari.

Como é trabalhar na JDE Peet's?

Somos pessoas unidas pelas possibilidades de chá e café. Na JDE Peet's, nós nos desenvolvemos com a liberdade de buscar oportunidades e de provocar novas ideias para causar grande impacto.

Nossa ambição é simples: despertar possibilidades de café e chá.

Job Description

AUIB seeks a strategic, collaborative, values-driven leader to serve as the Associate Dean of the College of Dentistry. The Associate Dean will have an ambitious vision for AUIB Dentistry that harnesses talent, creativity, and diversity. The Associate Dean will support the dean, who is the administrative and educational head of the College of Dentistry.

This Position Will Be Responsible For

  • Recruiting and retaining the college’s clinical faculty and staff in response to programmatic needs and encouraging their professional development.
  • In consultation with the chairs and directors of the concerned departments and divisions and appropriate committees, as specified in the policies, recommend to the college dean the appointment, tenure, promotion, retention, sabbatical leave, annual salary increase and retirement actions of any faculty member and administrative officer of the college.
  • Developing the clinical component of the college’s curriculum of the College.
  • Developing clinical continuing education and post-graduate programs to develop the advanced skills of practicing dentists.
  • Securing, in consultation with the Dean, the necessary accreditation and regulatory affairs associated with the profession and practice of dentistry.
  • Establishing the necessary academic quality assurance system within the college in line with those of the university as a whole leads to programmatic accreditation.
  • Overseeing, in consultation with the Dean, the appointment of academic staff and other technical and support staff of the College.
  • Representing, in the absence of the Dean, the College at meetings of the university, professional associations, governmental agencies, and other groups.
  • Developing the college’s practice and training facilities and creating an environment that facilitates research and scholarly activity.
  • Delegating duties to appropriate individuals or groups whenever indicated.
  • Performing additional tasks as the college dean or other suitable administrative officers of the university may specify.

Required Skills/Abilities

This position requires:

  • DDS, DMD, Ph.D., or the highest professional qualification in dentistry, and be a graduate of an accredited dental school.
  • Leadership experience in relevant academic institutions or universities for at least 10 years.
  • Evidence of academic and research innovations with a track record of scholarly and professional practice leadership in the field.
  • Demonstrated success in enhancing and advancing patient care, education, and research programs.
  • Demonstrated success in securing private, corporate, and/or governmental support to advance the college’s mission.

  • Demonstrated accomplishments in research and scholarship.
  • Operational understanding of American university educational systems.
  • Preferred experience working and living in the Middle East.

Application Requirements for Positions at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad

Required

To be considered for any role at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB), applicants are required to submit the following documents:

  • Cover letter: This should detail how your skills and experience align with the specific requirements of the position you are applying for.

Hypermarket Strategy Development and Implementation

In this role, you will be responsible for prevention, detection, response, and remediation activities, ensuring that information assets and technologies are adequately protected by leveraging various technologies such as Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and more.

  • Develop incident response runbooks, playbooks and SOPs with reference to different regulatory requirements
  • Evaluate the incident response readiness of different layers - people, process, technology
  • Detection & Analysis:
    • Respond to the cyber security incidents escalated from various channels including the 24/7 SOC team.
    • Respond to cyber security incidents in compliance with the local authority / regulatory requirements.
    • Assess the risk, impact and scope of the identified security threats

  • Containment, Eradication and Recovery:
    • Communicate with the stakeholders and provide guidance, recommendations to contain and eradicate the security incident
    • Participate in root cause analysis using forensic and other custom tools to identify any sources of compromise and/or malicious activities taking place.
    • Document and present investigative findings for high profile events and other incidents of interest.
  • Post incident activities:
    • Provide lessons learnt meeting to the stakeholders
    • Lead and keep track on the follow-up activities
    • Document the incident in the case management system and provide incident reports
  • Always ready to jump in, in the event of security incidents.

    • Requirements

Who We Are

Founded in 2010, Novibet is a leading GameTech company with a strong international presence. We operate in diverse markets, including Greece, Cyprus, Ireland, Canada, Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Ecuador, Finland, Italy, and New Zealand. With offices in Greece, Malta and Brazil, our mission is to deliver unparalleled sports betting and online gaming experiences to our rapidly expanding customer base.
Why Novibet

At Novibet, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work, consecutively from 2021, reflecting our commitment to developing a positive, inclusive, and supportive work environment. Join us, and you will be part of a team of over 1,000 people worldwide that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

What We are looking for

As a TechOps Specialist , you’ll tackle challenging problems, monitor live production systems, and ensure smooth platform operations. Your role includes investigating incidents, escalating issues, and working with development teams to resolve problems quickly. You’ll use tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Kibana), and Octopus Deploy to monitor, troubleshoot, and manage IT operations and deployments. Additionally, you'll document processes and build a knowledge base to improve efficiency. Be ready to adapt, collaborate, and solve real-world issues in a fast-paced environment.

  • Provide 1st level technical support to respond, investigate and resolve escalated incidents and service requests through the internal Service Management system
  • Direct escalation to internal support teams in cases that a resolution is not immediately possible and following up incidents through resolution
  • Perform incident management process taking any necessary steps to restore service and return the platform to normal operations as quickly as possible (Atlassian Jira ITSM)
  • Proactive monitoring of live production environment and event management based on internal dashboards and application health alerts generated by monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana)

  • Cooperate with developer teams, providing 1st level real time production logs investigation and retrieval (ELK Stack - Kibana)

  • Perform release deployment operations in the production environment (Octopus Deploy)
  • Hands-on handling and troubleshooting of a wide variety of support matters
  • Build internal knowledge base and document articles to improve internal incident management process
  • Speedily interpret and analyze data from various sources in a fast-moving and changing environment

What you bring

  • BSc or Academy degree in Information Technology or related field
  • At lease 1-2 years of experience in a production support environment
  • Prior experience in iGaming industry will be considered an asset
  • ITIL Foundation certified or equivalent experience working in an organization adopting ITIL best practices will be a strong asset
  • Experience working in an organization adopting Incident Management and IT operations best practices will be a strong asset
  • Microsoft certifications would be considered as an asset in this area
  • Nice to have experience with monitoring tools and applications such as Grafana, Zabbix, Prometheus, PRTG, Nagios and Kibana
  • Nice to have experience with ITSM tools like Atlassian Jira, Confluence and Opsgenie
  • Willingness to work both day and night shifts in a rotation
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Ability to efficiently solve problems and attention to detail

  • Realizar testes, monitoramento e manutenção das soluções para garantir a estabilidade e performance.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com times de TI e áreas de negócio para garantir a aderência das soluções às necessidades organizacionais.

  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. GENTE É O NOSSO NEGÓCIO E É POR ISSO QUE VALORIZAMOS NOSSOS COLABORADORES DE DIVERSAS FORMAS!

description:
The Property Specialist, Senior

The Property Specialist, Senior will be based at one of three Amentum sites in Iraq and serve the Operations and Maintenance Support Services (OMSS) contract in support of the U.S. Department of State. This position, under general supervision, will ensure that Government property is properly identified and tracked from acquisition to disposition. This position collaborates with and reports to the Logistics Manager to schedule and resolve inventory discrepancies. The duties and responsibilities listed below are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all inclusive.

DUTIES:

  1. Responsible for maintaining a safe workplace and ensuring that safety is the highest priority in the workplace.
  2. Comply with all Environmental Health & Safety and Quality Assurance requirements and goals.
  3. Provide information and materials to these divisions as necessary to ensure adequate and legal documentation.
  4. Ensure that property records are accessible and appropriately controlled and maintained consistent with the nature of the business, property type, applicable policies and procedures, and customer requirements.
  5. Minimize administrative cost by using common processes when possible.
  6. Develop and execute plans to inventory accountable property. The frequency and method of inventory may vary based on property type and established practices.
  7. Ensure that subcontract agreements address property to be furnished to or acquired by subcontractors or other elements and include appropriate property management requirements.
  8. Assess subcontractor property control systems to provide reasonable assurance that accountable property is managed in accordance with subcontract terms and conditions.
  9. Administer and manage physical inventories of Government Property.
  10. Work closely with lower-level Property Staff and Property Custodians to ensure overall accountability of assets.
  11. Mentor lower-level Property Staff and custodians in proper process and procedures as they relate to Government Property.
  12. Identify problem areas and recommend viable solutions.
  13. Perform physical inventories of Government Furnished Property (GFP) and Contractor Acquired Property (CAP), as directed by the Logistics and Property Manager.
  14. Assign Government Property Identification numbers (GP), prepare required schedule, and assist with identifying Lost, Damaged, & Destroyed property as well as excessive consumption.
  15. Track and record movement of all types of Government property. This includes movement from one point to another within a contractor’s facility, movement between facilities, for any purpose, and protection during movement.
  16. Assist on the preparation and safeguarding of administrative support files.
  17. Prepare hand receipts for all property custodian/hand receipt holders.
  18. Ensure compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Statement of Work (SOW) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).
  19. Complete routine spot checks of site assets.
  20. Maintain logs and status records to include lost, damaged, or destroyed items.
  21. Check LTDD packages for accuracy and completion.
  22. Assist with all other Logistics Warehouse duties as assigned.

REQUIRED:

  1. Minimum Acceptable Experience Level: Background in property and/or materials management.
  2. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
  3. Knowledge of the FAR and industry leading practices regarding Government Property.
  4. Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions and decimals.
  5. Collect data, define problems, and propose solutions.
  6. Understand how inventory affects company contractual obligations.
  7. Ability to clearly and concisely articulate services/requirements in writing.
  8. Ability to articulate in a clear and concise manner with Management and Trades Departments on a daily basis.
  9. Ability to lift materials and equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
  10. Ability to demonstrate analytical skills, researching skills.
  11. Ability to efficiently and effectively perform the technical requirements.
  12. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with ability to prioritize effectively and work with a sense of urgency.
  13. Ability to read, interpret and follow all Amentum /Logistic Management procedures, policies and guidelines.
  14. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions.
  15. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment that requires handling multiple tasks at a given time and rapidly adapting to changing priorities and schedules.
  16. Education: A high school diploma or GED. An undergraduate degree is preferred but can be replaced with additional years of Government Property Administration.
  17. Passport, Licenses and Certifications: As part of pre-contingency requirements, by the time the visa process starts, candidates must possess a valid passport with a minimum of 18 months remaining to expiration date with 8 blank pages. Valid drivers’ license from Home of Record.
  18. Security Vetting: Already possess a Moderate Risk Public Trust (MRPT) or be able to obtain a favorable MRPT certification prior to being hired is required for the position. Must maintain eligibility at the required certification level for the duration of the contract.
  19. Language Skills: Satisfactory English proficiency to meet job requirements and to adhere and comply with safety, health, and security measures.
  20. Medical: Successfully complete and pass the medical and dental examinations as required by Amentum and our customer for deployment to Iraq. Must maintain physical and dental requirements for duration of deployment.

DESIRED:

  1. Previous out of home country experience is highly desirable and previous work experience in harsh environmental conditions is a plus.
  2. Experience working with Amentum /PAE.

OTHER KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  1. Knowledge of ALL principles and processes involved in operating and supporting supply chain functions at a large-scale overseas facility.
  2. Experience providing excellent customer services.
  3. Cross-cultural sensitivity with an international perspective.
  4. Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  5. Expert computer skills, specifically in Microsoft Word and Excel.
  6. Ability to become an active and functioning member of a team.
  7. Must have the ability to be innovative and be an agent for change.
  8. Expert communication skills to facilitate and disseminate information.

Fastmarkets is an industry-leading price-reporting agency (PRA) and information provider for global commodities, providing price data, news, analytics and events for the agriculture, forest products, metals and mining and new-generation energy markets.

Fastmarkets' data is critical for customers seeking to understand and predict dynamic, sometimes opaque markets, enabling trading and risk management. Fastmarkets is a global business with a history dating back to 1865 and is built on trust and deep market knowledge. It has more than 600 employees spread across global locations in the UK, US, China, India, Singapore, Brazil, Belgium, Finland and beyond.

Fastmarkets is an industry-leading price-reporting agency (PRA) and information provider for global commodities, providing price data, news, analytics and events for the agriculture, forest products, metals and mining and new-generation energy markets.

Fastmarkets' data is critical for customers seeking to understand and predict dynamic, sometimes opaque markets, enabling trading and risk management. Fastmarkets is a global business with a history dating back to 1865 and is built on trust and deep market knowledge. It has more than 600 employees spread across global locations in the UK, US, China, India, Singapore, Brazil, Belgium, Finland and beyond.

Job Description

The Role

Create impactful and engaging content across various formats, including newsletters, presentations, data visualizations and more. You will transform data and written content into compelling layouts, designs and graphics that showcase our expertise, consistently delivering business-critical intelligence to our customers. You will also embrace and implement new production technologies and workflows to optimize efficiency and enhance the visual appeal of our outputs.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

Content delivery, design and development

  • Partner with reporters, analysts, economists and editors and other stakeholders to lay out newsletters, reports, whitepapers and studies quickly without compromising in quality, ensuring they meet the highest standards of design, clarity and visual consistency.
  • Apply your expertise with Adobe InDesign to produce professional, publication-ready layouts
  • Design visually engaging and informative charts, graphs and infographics that transform complex data into actionable insights using tools such as Excel (required) and PowerPoint (preferred).
  • Take a data-driven approach to content design, combining layout expertise with a flair for storytelling to produce compelling, user-centric products.
  • Proactively suggest visual improvements and creative solutions that enhance the effectiveness of our business-critical prices, forecasts and market intelligence.

Process improvement & efficiency

  • Leverage automation tools (e.g. templates, stylesheets, repeatable workflows, scripts) to streamline repetitive tasks and optimize workflows, freeing up time for more strategic and creative initiatives.
  • Implement and follow quality assurance processes to maintain accuracy, brand consistency and customer satisfaction.
  • Embrace a culture of innovation, continuously exploring new tools and methods to evolve how we deliver content and engage users.
  • Contribute ideas for content personalization and segmentation based on user preferences and behaviour, tailoring presentations and other deliverables for maximum impact.

KEY INTERFACES

  • You report to the Production Team Leader.
  • You will work closely with cross-functional teams, contributing to a supportive environment that fosters knowledge sharing and maximizes team performance.
  • You will cultivate strong working relationships with reporters, editors, researchers and analysts based on trust and proven ability.
  • You will be receptive to mentoring and coaching from colleagues and contribute to team efforts aimed at improving consistency and operational efficiency.
Qualifications

We recruit talented, dynamic people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, all united by a belief in our mission to provide the world’s leading and most trusted price reporting, events, and intelligence service for the markets we serve. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to creating a fully inclusive workplace, where everyone feels able to participate and contribute meaningfully.

If you are open-minded, curious, resilient, solutions-oriented and committed to promoting equality, then read on...

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

We are looking for an individual who is highly motivated, driven, and have a passion to be part of a fast-paced, successful team. Being a strong team player is also important as well as someone who is happy to work flexibly.

  • Highly motivated and creative, thriving in a fast-paced, deadline-driven but collaborative environment.
  • High degree of proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, especially InDesign (must-have), with experience in Illustrator, InCopy, Photoshop and Acrobat Pro.
  • Advanced Excel skills for data visualization (must-have); experience in PowerPoint and chart automation tools is a strong plus.
  • Experience with or curiosity about automation tools and their application in production workflows.
  • Tech-savvy and adaptable, with a drive to learn and embrace new tools and production technologies.
  • Able to translate complex data into clear, engaging visuals and narratives, tailoring output for diverse audiences and platforms.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • A positive attitude to change, adapting quickly and helping inspire others.
  • Excellent communicator and collaborator; able to navigate feedback and align with evolving business priorities.
  • Fluent in English.

If you're excited about the role but your experience, skills or qualifications don't perfectly align, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Additional Information

Our Values

Fastmarkets people come from all different walks of life. It’s this mix of brilliant personalities, experiences and insights that gives us that warm, open, and friendly culture you can feel as soon as you meet us. But however wonderfully different we all are, there are six things we all have in common – and they form our Fastmarkets values.

Created by our own employees to reflect some of the personal traits that Fastmarkets people have, our values are key to what makes our culture unique. They reflect who each of us are and they're embedded in everything we do. Our values are:

  • METRICS DRIVEN. We use insights to improve our customers’ experience and our business performance
  • ACCOUNTABLE. We are accountable to ourselves and those we work with: we keep our promises and get things done
  • GROWTH MINDSET . This value enables us to be nimble to the changing realities and operate with a sense of urgency
  • INCLUSIVE. We are inclusive and respectful, celebrating each of us and giving everyone a deep sense of belonging with the desire to bring their best self to work every day.
  • CUSTOMER CENTRIC. We are customer-centric in all that we do
  • COLLABORATIVE. We are collaborative, able to work across teams and capitalise on the diversity of intellect, perspectives, and experiences.

You’ve read a little about us – now it’s over to you!

If you like what you’ve read so far and think you can see yourself as a Fastmarkets person, it’s time to fill in your application form. This form is an important part of the selection process: it’s used to determine whether or not you’ll be chosen to have an interview and acts as a basis for the questions we’ll ask you on the day.

It’s vital that you try to capture all the relevant information we have asked for on the form so we can get a good feel for who you are and why you’re great.

description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - SPECIAL PROJECTS What We Do

The Special Projects team at Epic is responsible for executing high-impact projects that push the envelope to define the future of real-time graphics and gaming technology (The Matrix Awakens, Lumen in the Land of Nanite). In collaboration with the Unreal Engine team, we strive to put our technology and knowledge into the hands of users, empowering developers and content creators with the most powerful suite of real-time tools in the world.

What You'll Do

The Epic Games Research & Development team is searching for an experienced hands-on Research Engineer. The ideal candidate will bring a passion for digital humans and experience with machine learning and animation tech. Epic Games creates and deploys advanced computer-vision, computer-graphics and machine learning technologies to transform the production and consumption of digital media. This includes physics based simulation, ML based character animation, neural and inverse rendering and automated generative animation techniques among others. At Epic R&D we research, develop and deploy such technologies for Epic’s Unreal Engine and other Epic Products.

In this role, you will
  • Research and prototype machine learning and generative approaches for game content creation
  • Work with development engineers and product engineers to deploy and productize novel technology results in Epic products
  • Engage with the scientific community, contribute domain knowledge and advice in support of strategically relevant R&D efforts

  • To contribute deep expertise and actionable knowledge in collaboration with other researchers and engineers at Epic Games. Tech transfer will typically involve working with Research Engineers and/or Software Engineers to provide expert technical guidance and implementation
  • To guide and mentor junior researchers and students in the internship program
What we're looking for
  • PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline
  • Proven applied research impact in shipping titles
  • Strong analytical and reasoning skills with an emphasis on innovative and practical solutions
  • Excellent programming skills with a preference for experience with Python and C++
  • Experience working in common ML frameworks such as PyTorch or Tensorflow, and rapid prototyping in Python
  • In-depth knowledge in one or more of the following areas: real-time graphics, computer vision, machine learning, animation, large-language models, speech recognition, speech synthesis, linguistics, performance-capture, 3D reconstruction
EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process.

  • Second language - Spanish or French preferred

We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. description:
EBANX is a global fintech founded in 2012 with a mission to be the leading payments partner in rising markets. With its own technology and infrastructure, combined with in-depth knowledge of the Latin American market, EBANX allows these companies to connect to hundreds of payment methods in different countries in the region. We believe that it is only possible to innovate with diversity, so we cherish differences in gender, race, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, religion and age. Plurality is what makes our Big Dream possible.

We are called ebankers and we are changing the way people buy, connect, and live globally. Let's make history together?

About the Position: We are looking for a Mid-Level Data Reliability Engineer to join our Data Platform Engineering team responsible for our platform that facilitates the visualization and communication between ebankers. You will work in conjunction with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Analysts Engineers, and Software Engineering teams to ensure the reliable delivery of data that supports business decisions. And will mainly participate in the development of data governance solutions and DBRE initiatives.

As a DRE inside this team, you will be responsible for:

  • Ensuring the quality, reliability, and availability of data in large-scale systems.
  • Developing and maintaining robust, fault-tolerant data pipelines.
  • Implementing and improving monitoring and alerting systems to detect issues in real time.
  • Building and maintaining backup, recovery, and automation solutions to enhance data reliability.
  • Investigating and resolving data quality issues, such as inconsistencies and duplicates.
  • Collaborating with teams from different departments, including Engineering, Data Science, and Operations, to ensure efficient use of data.
  • Defining and monitoring data reliability metrics, like SLAs and SLOs, to maintain high standards.

What is indispensable for the job?

  • Experience with developing data pipelines or automating data-related tasks.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or Scala.
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases (e.g., BigQuery, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch).
  • Practical experience with data services in at least one Cloud platform: AWS or GCP.
  • Familiarity with data quality concepts.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work in a team.

What else we would love to see?

  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow).
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform).
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).
  • Understanding of basic SRE principles applied to data.
  • Experience with deploying and monitoring cloud infrastructure.

EBANX offers:

  • A challenging environment, with opportunities to grow;

  • Semi flexible hours (8 hours a day - Monday to Friday);

  • EBANX Flexible: monthly Day Off from February to November, birthday Day Off and Rest up Month - one month of paid leave every three years of work anniversary.
  • EBANX Family: Daycare assistance, extended leave for caregivers and support program for children and pregnant women;
  • EBANX Health: Health and Dental Insurance, with subsidy for dependents, and medicine subsidy for ebankers;
  • Life Insurance: Life Insurance 100% paid by EBANX
  • Hello ebanker: psychology, finance and legal orientation.

Quem somos?

A LEVTY é uma empresa de serviços em transformação digital corporativa. Nossos especialistas possuem alto nível técnico, sendo boa parte desse conhecimento formado e consolidado no dia a dia do trabalho.

Ficou claro que pessoas são a alma do nosso negócio, não é?! Somos uma empresa jovem, com uma equipe altamente escalável e que cresce de forma sustentável.

O que é preciso para entrar no nosso time?

  • Paixão por tecnologia aliada ao potencial técnico! Para nós, essa combinação é um dos maiores diferenciais para fazer parte de uma equipe de alto desempenho.

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharias ou afins são as que mais buscamos.

O que você fará em seu dia a dia?

Temos um dia a dia bem dinâmico. Não trabalhamos somente com desenvolvimento e codificação, os times são auto organizados e todos os membros têm oportunidade de participar de toda esteira de construção de um Software, desde o levantamento e especificação de requisitos, definição de arquitetura, modelagem, implementação, testes, garantia de qualidade, até a implantação e manutenção de sistemas. Você poderá se desenvolver em várias áreas!

O trabalho é realizado em times colaborativos, totalmente focados em atingir os melhores resultados para cada cliente. Utilizamos metodologias ágeis e nossos Engenheiros e Engenheiras de Software possuem perfil full stack, trabalhando na plataforma SYDLE ONE.

As tecnologias utilizadas são: Javascript, Elasticsearch, React, API REST, entre outras.

Gostou da oportunidade? Entenda nossa seleção.

Ao cadastrar seu currículo, ele será analisado pelo nosso RH e, caso seja selecionado, entraremos em contato com você para informar sobre a nossa seleção - que ocorrerá em três etapas (Teste de Lógica, Bate-papo RH e Bate-papo Técnico). Portanto, verifique se seu contato no currículo está atualizado e confira sempre seu e-mail e telefone :)

Uma LEVTY para todos!

Entendemos que a inovação só nasce com a diversidade e sabemos da importância de cada um para a construção de um ambiente de trabalho autêntico e plural. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas, sem exceção, são abertas para todas as pessoas, e nossa seleção será adaptada de acordo com a necessidade de cada um!

Confira nossos benefícios!

Sabemos que pessoas diferentes possuem necessidades diferentes. Por isso, não há sentido em engessar nossos benefícios! Nos preocupamos em proporcionar um pacote com incentivos variados, para que cada colaborador usufrua da forma mais adequada à sua realidade!

Somos o Grupo Kolplast, empresa líder no seguimento de insumos médico-hospitalares, localizada na cidade de Itupeva.

Sobre as responsabilidades e atribuições:

Realizar abastecimento e ajuste de máquinas de injeção plástica e moldes, conforme as especificações técnicas e as ordens de produção(OP).

Identificar o lote, ajustar os parâmetros, preparar a matéria-prima, testar, realizar a limpeza nos silos e demais ajustes e regulagens para a operação da máquina.

Monitorar o tempo de funcionamento de cada máquina. Operar ponte rolante, para realização do setup.

Realizar pequenos reparos como, lubrificação, limpeza, regulagens e calibragens, acionando a equipe de manutenção, quando necessário.

Orientar operadores de máquinas quanto à operação segura e eficiente dos equipamentos e processos de injeção plástica.

Preencher relatórios de produção, manutenção e controle de qualidade, mantendo a documentação organizada e acessível para auditorias internas e externas.

Realizar e zelar pela limpeza do setor e das máquinas sob sua responsabilidade, destinando de forma adequada todos os resíduos gerados durante a sua atuação.

Manter-se atualizado quanto a novos procedimentos e processos inerentes a sua área de atuação.

Participar de reuniões de produtividade, quando convocado.

Seguir as diretrizes de Boas Práticas de Fabricação e segurança no trabalho conforme normas internas e regulatórias.

Executar outras atividades correlatas do mesmo nível de dificuldade dentro da sua área de atuação, quando solicitado.

Ensino Médio Completo;

Experiência mínima de 1 ano com troca de moldes de injeção plástica;

Conhecimento de processos de injeção plástica;

Conhecimento prático no manejo de moldes e controle de métodos;

Residir em Itupeva ou possuir fácil acesso;

Horário de Trabalho: De segunda a sexta-feira das 12h48min às 22h, com sábados alternados das 06h às 12h.

Desejável:

Formação técnica em Mecânica, Plásticos ou Processos Industriais;

Possuir a NR 11 e NR12;

title: Articulador Social- Fortaleza/CE
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição em São Paulo, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia; e Iniciativa de trocar resíduos recicláveis por descontos na conta de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O Articulador Social atuará na linha de frente do projeto Rede Liderança, Oficinas e Palestras comunitárias na área de concessão da Enel SP. A função interage diretamente com os parceiros envolvidos (Associações de moradores, representantes de bairro, ONGs, grupos produtivos comunitários, instituições religiosas, universidades, instituições públicas e privadas), organizando os eventos e realizando os mesmos.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Preparação e condução das reuniões de liderança com metodologia de mediação de grupos e dinâmicas;
  2. Organização e realização de Oficinas para mulheres e Palestras comunitárias;
  3. Manter um canal de comunicação próximo e direto com os parceiros, possibilitando a melhoria da qualidade dos serviços prestados pela Enel, minimizando conflitos e gerando valor compartilhado;
  4. Criar e propor estratégias de abordagem com os grupos;
  5. Realizar visitas institucionais para identificação das lideranças comunitárias;
  6. Proceder com o mapeamento e análise dos perfis das lideranças comunitárias;
  7. Prospectar líderes comunitários para fins de aplicação de questionários;
  8. Analisar e mapear os resultados e objetivos alcançados;
  9. Identificar temas levantados pelos participantes dos grupos e propor as temáticas das reuniões;
  10. Enviar relatórios periódicos de desempenho das ações do projeto;
  11. Prospectar possíveis grupos produtivos de interesse da ENEL;
  12. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização;
  13. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internos;
  14. Realizar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade do setor.

title: Registered Respiratory Therapist
description:
Join to apply for the Registered Respiratory Therapist role at Lehigh Valley Health Network

Lehigh Valley Health Network (LVHN) is home to nearly 23,000 colleagues who make up our talented, vibrant, and diverse workforce. Join a team that delivers excellence and be part of an organization nationally recognized, forward-thinking, and offering great opportunities to do impactful work.

LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. We are a Magnet™ Hospital, awarded five times by the American Nurses Credentialing Center for nursing excellence. Several of our hospitals received an 'A' grade on the Hospital Safety Grade from The Leapfrog Group in 2020, reflecting our commitment to safety, teamwork, compassion, and technology.

Summary

Administers all forms of respiratory care, both critical and general therapy, managing respiratory and pulmonary care for designated patients. Provides assessment, support, treatment, and diagnostics as part of the healthcare team.

Job Duties

  1. Evaluate, manage, and care for patients with cardiopulmonary deficiencies and abnormalities.
  2. Maintain respiratory equipment inventory and ensure adequate stock.
  3. Provide respiratory therapy as ordered by physicians, following established standards.
  4. Train staff, including physicians and students, on respiratory therapy issues.
  5. Manage mechanical ventilators, BiPAP, and monitor respiratory status.
  6. Perform emergency resuscitations, maintain airways, and measure ventilator parameters in critical care.
  7. Conduct arterial blood gas analysis and interpret pulse oximetry results.
  8. Educate patients on sleep apnea, CPAP machines, and related equipment.
  9. Set up diagnostic sleep studies.
  10. Administer respiratory medications via aerosol treatment, chart responses, and monitor progress.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Associate’s Degree from an accredited RRT program.
  • Less than 1 year of experience.
  • Proficiency in respiratory therapy techniques and equipment troubleshooting.
  • RRT certification (NBRC) and Pennsylvania state license within 1 year.
  • ACLS certification within 60 days.
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification within 30 days.
  • PALS and NRP certifications within 60 days.
  • RCP licensure upon hire.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited RRT program.

Physical Demands

Ability to lift and carry 40-50 lbs, perform patient transfers, and stand/walk frequently. Activities may include kneeling, bending, squatting, and performing CPR.

This position description reflects current duties and conditions but may be revised as needed. Lehigh Valley Health Network is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion.

description:

About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

Compensation Data

The typical hiring range for this role is $91,000 to $125,000 annually and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, location, etc. In addition to your pay, Kerry offers benefits such as a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and retirement contribution (all benefits and incentives are subject to eligibility requirements).

What You'll Do

ORGANIZATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

Demonstrates leadership in the areas of safety and environment. This requires observing and enforcing safety rules and practices, encouraging safe work behaviors, and promptly correcting conditions and unsafe behavior, which may lead to accidents.

Continually endorse the Quality & Food Safety Policies, assure conformance to all requirements of the Quality & Food Safety Management Systems, & take action to properly report failures of these systems to site management.

Provide support and leadership to site operations management through implementation of HSE programs, procedures, and education initiatives focused on compliance assurance, incident reduction, and risk mitigation.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Essential Functions:

1.Manage all environmental permits and program requirements specific to the site.

2.Lead implementation and management of site ISO 14001 Environmental Management System.

3.Maintain and report HSE records to ensure adherence to corporate polices and/or regulatory requirements. Includes, but not limited to, OSHA 300 log, incident records, safety metrics, training, inspections, permits, etc.

4.Manages, organizes, coordinates and implements all safety and environmental programs and the associated documented procedures to ensure employee and facility safety. Develops and manages tracking systems associated with monitoring performance against site goals.

5.Responsible for overall coordination of safety training within the facility in accordance with pertinent regulations.

6.Advisor to Safety Committee, responsible for coordinating and implementing approved recommendations of this committee.

7.Responsible for following, monitoring and enforcing safety rules, policies and procedures and applying corrective action when necessary. Responsible for developing awareness and promotional programs aimed at operational safety and a safe work environment.

8.Completes safety portion of new hire and contractor orientation.

9.Reports monthly and annual safety statistics to corporate entities.

10.Tracks employee safety training to ensure compliance with regulatory mandates and company policy.

11.Support site management with the investigation of HSE incidents at the site. Where necessary, lead investigation process and/or collaborate with appropriate corporate staff on serious incidents.

12.Communicate HSE incidents and corrective actions in a timely, thorough, and effective manner.

13.Partner with Human Resources to monitor the status of all open Workers Compensation claims and coordinate activities to minimize lost and/or restricted work days.

14.Maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) original file and index by entering new and updating SDS when received, copying and distribution of SDS for all departments involved, filing in master book in front offices.

Marginal Functions:

1.Writes work orders as necessary.

2.Provides technical information on facility safety and government regulations as they pertain to health and safety to the Rochester site.

3.Recommends policies and procedures ensuring all employees maintain safety and regulatory compliance.

4.Responsible for knowledge and implementation of all upcoming Federal and State legislation relative to safety and ensures informing the various departments of upcoming changes.

5.Attends and participates in the bi-weekly managers operations meeting and daily stand-up meetings.

What You'll Need To Succeed

EDUCATION:Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Safety, Industrial or Environmental Engineering.

EXPERIENCE:

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Enterprise Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

4 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Enterprise Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Canonical
Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective of reducing risk and churn, facilitating the adoption of new products or services, and supporting expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. By clearly understanding their customers' objectives, the CSM can align expectations, suggest a large range of additional services or product capacity to increase loyalty, alleviate any pain points, and help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.
We are growing our Customer Success team to continue to offer thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open-source infrastructure and applications. To provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer, CSMs are specialized in one of the following segments:

  • Mass - SMEs or large businesses starting their journey with Canonical
  • Focus - Large companies with established ARR
  • Step Growth - a selection of high-potential customers
All CSMs contribute to business support at the company level for all remaining, not-yet-assigned customers (Tech segment), including our Store customers.
Location: This role will be based remotely.
What your day will look like
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Elaborate and coordinate complex projects in interaction with developers, IT managers and decision makers from various industries.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Field Engineering and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Manage a portfolio of customers in a specific geographic region and identify growth opportunities or renewal risks in coordination with Sales.
  • Experience running a disciplined, weekly customer and business review process with cross-functional teams, identifying and prioritizing blockers, and driving resolution through corporate product and engineering teams
  • Serve as a customer advocate internally and influence Canonical products roadmaps, Canonical websites, documentation, processes and people to improve customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Supporting customers through reactive ticket requests.
  • Create campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
What we are looking for in you
The ideal candidate would display impeccable customer-facing skills with a passion for cloud and data centre infrastructure technologies. We are also looking for:
  • Minimum 5 years of work experience with a strong relation to IT and with exposure to projects related to at least one of these topics: Linux OS, data applications, storage, cloud computing, networking, security, migration, IoT.
  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to guide a conversation about complex software.
  • Experience building and improving internal processes while maintaining timely delivery to customer-related projects.
  • A true team player capable of interacting with all departments and at all levels, both internally and externally.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies.
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Spanish and Portuguese alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • Experience with Salesforce, Jira and CRMs is a big plus!
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Lead Solution Engineer (f/m/d)
