About the role

Taktile exists to create value for organizations through smarter and safer decisions at scale. Our goal is to become the world's leading software provider for automated decision-making in the financial services industry and, to date, our software has been used by our customers to power over 1,000,000 critical business decisions every day.

Taktile is based in Berlin, London, and New York City. We’re backed by some of the world’s leading investors and show great traction with scale-ups and large enterprises across the financial services and insurance industry. We are looking to build on this success by growing our sales team, professionalizing our go-to-market, and acquiring more customers.

That’s where you come in.

As a Solution Engineer, you are core to our mission of transforming our customer's decisioning infrastructure to enable them to optimize and automate complex and mission-critical business decisions. You will work in partnership with Taktile's Sales Team and ensure our customers get value from Taktile throughout their entire lifecycle. You are a trusted advisor to our customers and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize value by using Taktile in their decisioning tech stack.

If you are passionate about state-of-the-art tech products, have gathered a few years of experience working with Python and customers, and enjoy working as part of an awesome team that empowers you to grow, then we think you'll love this job!

ABOUT YOU

  • You know how to build strong customer relationships with stakeholders across different levels of seniority, including both technical stakeholders in an organization (e.g., Principal Engineers, Data Scientists) as well as business stakeholders (e.g., Risk Managers, Credit Analysts).
  • You are curious and customer-centric. You enjoy learning about our customers’ and prospects’ businesses and helping them solve challenges.
  • You are able to plan and manage project scope, expectations, and timelines. You will need to manage multiple projects across customers that will be at different parts of their journey with Taktile.
  • You are humble and have a growth mindset, with a willingness to learn new skills and methodologies and bring best practices into our business.
  • You are collaborative and work well with your peers in Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering, and the Customer Success team.
  • You are creative and proactive - you’re always looking for ways to stand out with customers and prospects.
  • You have excellent written and spoken English.

What You'll Do

  • You discover and translate customer's strategic priorities and problem statements into high-impact use cases leveraging Taktile during the sales process and throughout the entire customer value journey including adoption, expansion, and renewal.
  • You build demos, support our sales team and customers in building business cases, and design and scope proof of value projects which demonstrate the value Taktile delivers for the customer within a short amount of time.
  • You collaborate with partners and customers to design and build solutions in Taktile's Decisioning Platform.
  • You lead proof-of-value projects and can communicate the value opportunity of a full implementation and the corresponding strategic roadmap to senior stakeholders up to C-level executives.
  • You onboard and work with various of our customers' teams (domain experts, product, engineering, data science) to help them solve real-world problems. You understand people and technology, and are proficient and diligent in writing and testing Python code and committed to providing an excellent experience and fast time to value to Taktile’s customers.
  • You will work with product management to translate your knowledge of customer problems into product insights to shape Taktile's product roadmap.
  • You will create re-usable collateral, best practices & tools to help scale your knowledge and expertise across the solution engineering function.
  • You lead the discovery for new use cases and implement them on the platform to assess product-solution fit. You provide feedback to our product team and share results of your discovery with go-to-market functions.

Ideal, But Not Required

  • Live for Customer Value: You have at least 5+ years of experience working within Enterprise / "high touch" Solution Engineering, as a technical Customer Success Manager / Engineer in a B2B SaaS company or as (Technical) Senior Consultant.
  • Technical expertise: You have a general understanding of REST APIs (design, integration, authentication).
  • Data & Analytics: You have experience in applying and optimizing statistical and machine learning models to solve business problems. You are familiar with the state-of-the-art data & analytics tech stack and workflow automation platforms which help you creatively solve your customers' automation and optimization problems.
  • Business domain expertise: You have acquired domain expertise in the financial services industry (banking, insurance, capital markets, payments, etc.).

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you, and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.
  • Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company.
  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.
  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.
  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.
  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books, or take classes.
  • Use the equipment of your choice including a meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.
  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism, and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms.

About us

Taktile is building the world's leading software platform for running critical and highly-automated decisions. Our customers use our product to catch fraudsters, prevent money laundering, and expand access to credit for small businesses, among many other use cases. Taktile is already making millions of such decisions across the globe every day.

Network Engineer – Citrix ADC to F5 Migration Specialist

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Key responsibilities/Expectations from the Role

  • Lead the end-to-end migration from Citrix ADC to F5 BIG-IP, ensuring a smooth and efficient process.
  • Collaborate with the Engineering team to develop migration strategies and incorporate their recommendations into the project.
  • Assess existing Citrix ADC configurations, including load balancing, SSL offloading, authentication, and security policies.
  • Design and implement F5 BIG-IP architectures that meet business and technical requirements.
  • Configure and test F5 BIG-IP features such as LTM, SSL/TLS profiles, persistence, iRules, and high availability.
  • Perform traffic cutover to F5 BIG-IP in a phased manner to minimize service disruptions.
  • Conduct functional and performance testing to validate migration success and address any issues.
  • Optimize F5 BIG-IP configurations for performance, security, and reliability.
  • Document new F5 BIG-IP configurations and provide training to the Operations and Support teams.
  • Offer post-migration support and address any issues identified during the transition phase.
  • Monitor and log network traffic to ensure proactive issue identification and resolution.

Must Have

  • Strong experience with Citrix ADC (NetScaler) and F5 BIG-IP (LTM).
  • Deep knowledge of load balancing, SSL/TLS offloading, session persistence, and traffic management.
  • Experience in high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) configurations.
  • Familiarity with security features such as WAF, access control policies, and authentication mechanisms.
  • Proficiency in writing and troubleshooting F5 iRules.
  • Experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools.
  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Good to Have

  • Ability to work closely with Engineering and Operations teams to align project strategies and incorporate feedback.
  • Excellent documentation and reporting skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for presenting technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Awareness of security best practices in automation and the ability to implement secure coding principles.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • F5 Certified Administrator (F5-CA) or F5 Certified Technical Specialist (F5-CTS) preferred.
  • Citrix certifications such as CCP-N (Citrix Certified Professional – Networking) are a plus.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in network engineering, with significant experience in Citrix ADC and F5 BIG-IP migration or administration.
  • Experience in enterprise-level network environments and large-scale migrations.

description:
Graphisoft empowers teams to design great buildings through award-winning software solutions, learning programs, and professional services for the AEC industry. Our award-winning products and solutions support OPEN BIM for workflow transparency, longevity, and data accessibility for built assets. Archicad , the architects’ BIM software of choice, offers a complete end-to-end design and documentation workflow for architectural and integrated architectural and engineering practices of any size. BIMx , the most popular mobile and web BIM app, extends the BIM experience to include all stakeholders in the building design, delivery, and operations lifecycle. BIMcloud , the AEC industry’s first and most advanced cloud-based team collaboration solution, makes real-time collaboration possible across the globe regardless of the size of the project and the speed or quality of the team members’ network connection. DDScad solutions support users with intelligent Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) design tools, integrated calculations, and comprehensive documentation of all building system disciplines. Graphisoft is part of the Nemetschek Group. To learn more, visit more visit

We are looking for a Senior Treasury/Finance Analyst to join our dynamic and collaborative team. This position requires a proactive and analytical profile with strong communication skills, especially in English, as you will interact with both domestic and international clients and team members.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the entire treasury workflow, including accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, cash flow forecasting, invoicing, and supporting financial reporting, audit processes, and accounting closings.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and monitor Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes, including national and international aging reports.
  • Communicate directly with clients, providing clarification on billing issues and following up on overdue accounts.
  • Manage the full treasury process, including payment forecasting, bank reconciliations, and balance monitoring.
  • Collaborate with internal departments (Sales, Accounting, Controlling, HR) to ensure data consistency and accurate postings in the ERP system.
  • Issue invoices and tax documents for both domestic and international clients.
  • Review and verify billing information, especially concerning withholding taxes.
  • Develop and maintain financial reports and spreadsheets.
  • Participate in monthly and annual accounting closings.
  • Analyze and validate accounting data in financial systems.
  • Support internal audit requests.
  • Manage relationships with banks and financial institutions.
  • Handle registrations with government agencies for public sector sales.
  • Monitor and maintain control over the company’s insurance policies.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Economics, Accounting, or related fields.
  • 5 years of experience in Finance, Accounting or Treasury.
  • Advanced English knowledge.
  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Preferred knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 – Business Central.
  • Desirable experience with Power BI, Master Data, or other automation tools.
  • Proactive, analytical, and strong communication skills.

If you think this description fits you, come and join us!

description:
Sobre nós:

A Prolog está desde 2016 transformando a Gestão de Frotas através da tecnologia, com presença em 3 países e fazendo a diferença em mais de 1.000 operações de transportes!

Na Prolog, não paramos de aprender porque conhecimento é o nosso combustível; não assumimos nada, guiamo-nos por dados para garantir a rota certa; temos foco no que importa, sem desviar da faixa de nossas prioridades; valorizamos o resultado porque sabemos onde queremos chegar; com capricho e precisão para cada entrega rodar perfeitamente e; não nos conformamos com ineficiência porque nossa frota é feita para rodar em alta performance!

Através dos nossos módulos de Gestão de Pneus, Gestão de Manutenção e Gestão de Checklist, levamos maior produtividade, precisão e previsibilidade para a gestão de frota dos nossos clientes!
Conheça mais sobre o nosso negócio clicando aqui!

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar na posição de Consultor Comercial Externo e você pode conferir os detalhes da nossa oportunidade abaixo, vem ver!

Importante: Nossa sede fica em Palhoça-SC e esta função é para atender todo o estado do Paraná pessoalmente.

O Consultor Comercial Externo será o principal responsável por expandir nossa atuação no mercado de frotas, transportes de cargas e logística, desenvolvendo relacionamentos consultivos com clientes, promovendo soluções personalizadas e impulsionando nossas metas de vendas e crescimento em 2025. Este papel exige habilidades estratégicas, conhecimento do setor e uma abordagem orientada a resultados, atuando diretamente para fortalecer nossa marca e aumentar a receita.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Identificar e abordar potenciais clientes dentro do mercado de frotas, transportes de cargas e logística;
  • Desenvolver estratégias de prospecção baseadas em dados de mercado e pipeline;
  • Realizar visitas presenciais a clientes para fortalecer relacionamentos e identificar necessidades específicas;
  • Apresentar soluções de forma consultiva, destacando benefícios e ROI para o cliente;
  • Conduzir negociações comerciais, alinhando expectativas e formalizando contratos de maneira clara e assertiva;
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos duradouros com clientes e parceiros estratégicos;
  • Identificar oportunidades de upselling e cross-selling dentro da carteira de clientes;
  • Assegurar a satisfação e fidelização do cliente por meio de acompanhamento de apoio ao time de CS;
  • Monitorar tendências e mudanças no setor de transportes e logística;
  • Acompanhar concorrentes e propor estratégias diferenciadas de posicionamento;
  • Colaborar com as áreas de marketing, produto e CS para alinhar demandas de mercado às soluções oferecidas;
  • Administrar uma carteira de clientes ativos e potenciais, priorizando oportunidades de maior impacto comercial;
  • Atualizar o CRM regularmente, garantindo precisão no funil de vendas;
  • Elaborar relatórios detalhados sobre visitas, pipeline e vendas realizadas;
  • Fornecer feedback de mercado e insights estratégicos para apoiar a tomada de decisões.

Para assumir essa missão você precisa ter:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas externas, preferencialmente no setor de frotas, transportes de cargas e logística;
  • Conhecimento técnico em gestão de frotas (TMS, telemetria, pneus, checklist, manutenção);
  • Familiaridade com indicadores financeiros e operacionais do setor, como CPK (Custo por Quilômetro Rodado).

Não é obrigatório, mas nossos olhos brilharão se você:

  • Experiência no mercado de pneus de carga ou soluções tecnológicas voltadas para logística;
  • Carteira de clientes estabelecida no setor de transportes;
  • Participação prévia em projetos estratégicos para frotas;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão de frotas (TMS, telemetria, Check List, Gestão de Pneus, Gestão de Combustíveis, Gestão de Frota, Gestão de Manutenção, etc.);
  • Domínio de metodologias de vendas consultivas, como SPIN Selling ou Challenger Sales.

Oferecemos ainda:

  • Apoio para custos com combustível, visando facilitar sua mobilidade no estado;

Você conhece a Bunge?

Distribuída em mais de 40 países, líder mundial em processamento de oleaginosas e uma das maiores produtoras e fornecedoras de óleos, gorduras e proteínas vegetais há mais de dois séculos, a Bunge trabalha com o propósito de conectar agricultores a consumidores para fornecer alimentos, ingredientes e combustíveis essenciais para o mundo. Há 117 anos no Brasil, contamos com mais de 100 unidades e somos uma das principais empresas de agronegócio e alimentos, líder em originação de grãos e em processamento de soja e trigo. Em todas as nossas cadeias de valor promovemos nossos negócios de maneira sustentável ao mesmo tempo que apoiamos o bem-estar social e econômico das comunidades onde atuamos. Valorizamos a diversidade de nossos times e buscamos talentos criativos com espírito de equipe e vontade de fazer a diferença. Em tudo o que fazemos, colocamos em prática nossos valores:

  • Atuar como um só time, promovendo a inclusão, a colaboração e o respeito;
  • Buscar a excelência, sendo ágeis, inovadores e eficientes;
  • Fazer o que é certo, agindo de forma segura, ética e sustentável.

Na Bunge, valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e trabalhamos em prol de uma cultura inclusiva e de pertencimento, com respeito e equidade. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas como são!

Nossa empresa possui uma sólida trajetória e estamos construindo um futuro repleto de oportunidades! Faça parte de nosso time e venha trilhar sua jornada profissional com a gente.

Missão do Cargo

Como advogado(a) nesta posição, você terá um papel fundamental na condução de assuntos relacionados ao EUDR (Regulamento da União Europeia sobre Produtos Livres de Desmatamento) e outras questões socioambientais. Você fornecerá suporte jurídico especializado e estratégico para garantir a conformidade com o EUDR, com foco na devida diligência em relação à origem dos produtos, à verificação do cumprimento da legislação aplicável nos países produtores (incluindo direitos humanos, direitos dos povos indígenas e comunidades locais) e à mitigação de riscos. Seu background generalista em áreas como Direito Tributário, Trabalhista e Compliance será um diferencial para uma atuação integrada e completa.

Atividades e Responsabilidades

Consultoria Jurídica:

  • Consultoria jurídica especializada para a área de direitos humanos e sustentabilidade em conformidade com o EUDR (Regulamento da União Europeia sobre Produtos Livres de Desmatamento), bem como nas demais áreas de legalidade exigidos pelo EUDR, como trabalhista, tributário, compliance, entre outras, baseada nos procedimentos e políticas internas da companhia.
  • Elaboração de pareceres e memorandos jurídicos com a avaliação de risco, com base na documentação analisada para evidenciar a devida diligência por parte da empresa.

Contencioso:

  • Análise de processos administrativos e judiciais,considerando os aspectos relacionados à conformidade com a EUDR.
  • Análise de documentos processuais, incluindo processo de licenciamento, licenças ambientais, estudos de impacto ambiental, autorizações de supressão vegetal, TAC, plano de manejo, etc.,verificando sua conformidade com os requisitos do EUDR.
  • Acompanhar e controlar o fluxo dos processos desenvolvidos por advogados externos,garantindo a conformidade com a estratégia da empresa em relação ao EUDR.

Compliance:

  • Realização de controles internos utilizando o sistema jurídico interno.
  • Acompanhamento legislativo e reporte à gerência e diretoria jurídica sobre os impactos das alterações legislativas no negócio, com foco em legislação socioambiental,incluindo atualizações e análises sobre o EUDR e outras regulamentações internacionais relevantes.

Gestão de Riscos:

  • Identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos, considerando os riscos legais, reputacionais e financeiros associados ao descumprimento do EUDR.
  • Elaboração de relatórios dedue diligenceem direitos humanos e sustentabilidade,com foco na diligência devida e os requisitos de rastreabilidade e transparência da cadeia de suprimentos do EUDR.

Outras atividades:

  • Participação em grupos de trabalho, internos e externos, interagindo com diferentesstakeholders,com foco em EUDR e outras questões socioambientais relevantes.
  • Prover treinamentos às áreas de interface.

Impacto/Dimensão

O(A) Advogado(a) desta posição desempenha um papel estratégico na mitigação de riscos e na geração de valor para a empresa, contribuindo diretamente para:

  • Redução de passivos ambientais e sociais: Através da análise criteriosa de documentos e da emissão de pareceres jurídicos, o(a) profissional contribui para a prevenção de multas e processos judiciais, gerando uma economia à empresa.
  • Assegurar a conformidade com a legislação e as melhores práticas: A atuação do(a) advogado(a) garante que os projetos e as operações da empresa estejam em conformidade com as leis e normas socioambientais, evitando sanções e danos reputacionais. Isso envolve a análise de diversos documentos por ano e a emissão de pareceres que subsidiam decisões estratégicas à área de originação, sustentabilidade e direitos humanos.
  • Promoção da sustentabilidade e dos direitos humanos: O(A) profissional atua ativamente na implementação de políticas e práticas de sustentabilidade e direitos humanos, contribuindo para o alcance dos Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável. Isso inclui a participação em diversos projetos por ano, com alcance nacional e internacional, e a interação com diferentes stakeholders.
  • Fortalecimento da reputação da empresa: A atuação jurídica ética e responsável na área de sustentabilidade e direitos humanos contribui para o fortalecimento da imagem da empresa perante seus stakeholders, gerando valor para a marca e atraindo investimentos.

title: Manager, Renewals Sales LATAM
description:
At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!

At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.

Job Description

Palo Alto Networks is scaling its world-class strategy organization and looking for a Team Manager in the area of security services. Though our security services are successful both in the market as well as at preventing attackers, the landscape is continually changing and in need of innovation leadership. The Palo Alto Networks Strategy function is a focused team that works on our most mission-critical business challenges to drive and support our industry-leading growth.

As a Manager of the renewals Team, your efforts will directly impact the overall strategy and success of a world-leading cybersecurity business. You will collaborate on complex business and technology problems that are top-of-mind for our executives, particularly as those relate to key partnerships having strategic value to the business. You will lead initiatives with stakeholders to formulate mutually beneficial and measurable outcomes for technical and business objectives with strategic partners. You possess a unique blend of business insight, business strategy experience, big-picture thinking, influencing skills and ability to collaborate with a large number of constituents within Palo Alto Networks.

Your Impact

  • Manage the overall day-to-day renewal operations of assigned direct reports and districts/regions in the LATAM regions.
  • Motivate your direct reports to drive pipeline development and revenues through renewal sales efforts leveraging the partner network.
  • Ability to accurately forecast to leadership teams and drive a committed number on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis to SR. Manager and VP.
  • Coaching and development of subordinates, bi-weekly 121's.
  • Supervise and assist direct reports on large deals through to completion.
  • Evaluate, and document, your direct reports based on Key Metrics and goals set by Leadership.
  • Monitor the outbound efforts of assigned renewals reps by tracking and reporting weekly activities.
  • Collaborate with Sales Leaders to identify strategies to achieve sales goals and uncover new, high-value opportunities alongside renewals.
  • Provide accurate, ongoing reporting through the continuous update and maintenance of necessary reports in Salesforce.com and other tools and applications.
  • Provide support for renewal escalations and your assigned districts.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • At least 3+ years experience in managing diverse enterprise renewals/sales teams.
  • At least 3+ years experience in leading 8-15 people, in the office and remote work environments.
  • At least 3+ years experience in hiring, developing and retaining talent.
  • Proven experience with channel/partner sales models renewals/upsells.
  • Proven to consistently achieve renewal/sales team goals through your leadership.
  • Proven ability to learn new technology quickly, as well as adapt to changing needs.
  • Excellent communication skills - the ability to build cross-functional relationships.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills - the ability to work on many projects concurrently.
  • Excellent Microsoft Excel, Google Suite and Salesforce.com skills.

Additional Information

The Team

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are driven by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing salesperson – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

As a System Integration Engineer, your mission will be to contribute to the transformation and continuous evolution of the platforms that support our client's team:

We need someone like you to help our client in different fronts:

  • Manage a team of IT developers, accommodating each team member's preferences with the areas where workload is higher. Balance between team members' career path and product time-to-market is key.

  • +7 years of experience in Java with Spring Boot framework software development.
  • Sound experience on distributed architectures, both synchronous (API REST) and asynchronous (Kafka, MQ).

  • Broad SQL relational database knowledge.

  • Project Management skills (PM certification appreciated).
  • Communication skills: ability to adequately address messages and level of detail to each level in the organization.

Nice to have Technology Knowledge:

  • Python, ElasticSearch, WebServices (SOAP).
  • Exceptional working ethics, critical thinking skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work both autonomously and together with a multi-skilled distributed team.
  • Fluent in Spanish and in English.

Additional Information

  • Benefits and perks such as private medical insurance, life insurance, lunch and travel cards as part of the flexible remuneration package.
  • Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.
We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.
Sobre nós: A missão da Vantive
Na Vantive, estamos profundamente conectados por nossa missão. Independentemente de sua função na Vantive, seu trabalho tem um impacto positivo nas pessoas em todo o mundo. Você sentirá um senso de propósito em toda a organização, pois sabemos que nosso trabalho melhora os resultados para milhões de pacientes.
Os produtos e terapias da Vantive são encontrados em quase todos os hospitais do mundo, em clínicas e em casa. Por mais de 85 anos, fomos pioneiros em inovações médicas significativas que transformam os cuidados de saúde.
Juntos, criamos um lugar onde somos felizes, bem-sucedidos e inspiramos uns aos outros. É aqui que você pode fazer o seu melhor trabalho.
Junte-se a nós na interseção de salvar e prolongar vidas - onde seu propósito acelera nossa missão.
Seu papel na Vantive
AQUI É ONDE você constrói confiança para alcançar resultados
Junte-se a nós enquanto revolucionamos o cenário de tratamento médico e ajudamos a melhorar a vida de pacientes em todo o mundo. A Vantive planeja transformar nosso segmento de cuidados renais de aproximadamente US$ 5 bilhões em uma empresa independente de capital aberto. Aproveitaremos a nossa liderança no setor de cuidados renais, impulsionados pelo nosso foco na inovação, pela nossa paixão pelos pacientes e suas famílias e pela nossa experiência em excelência operacional. Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we must measure our progress towards this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. Your decision to complete the form and your answer will not harm you in any way. If you want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at .

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease
  • Cerebral palsy
  • Deaf or serious difficulty hearing
  • Diabetes
  • Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders
  • Epilepsy or other seizure disorder
  • Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome
  • Intellectual or developmental disability
  • Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD
  • Missing limbs or partially missing limbs
  • Mobility impairment, benefiting from the use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker, leg brace(s) and/or other supports
  • Nervous system condition, for example, migraine headaches, Parkinson’s disease, multiple sclerosis (MS)
  • Neurodivergence, for example, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities
  • Partial or complete paralysis (any cause)
  • Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for example, tuberculosis, asthma, emphysema
  • Short stature (dwarfism)
  • Traumatic brain injury

title: Data Quality & Governance Engineer
description:
Bold Metrics is the leading fit and sizing solution on the market today for the world’s top retailers and brands. We are a venture-backed startup that is making a big impact on the environment, forever changing the landscape of eCommerce. We are a remote-first company that is full of inspiring and friendly people.

We are currently searching for a Data Quality Engineer to join our fast-growing team. This position is for someone located in São Paulo, Brazil who is able to come into the office in-person at least once weekly. In this position you will have the opportunity to work with some of our biggest projects within the retail industry.

About You:

You are a humble, passionate, and experienced engineer that is looking for a collaborative and analytical Data Quality Engineering role to support the execution of our product deliveries and client reporting services. This comprises validating the data flow as a whole, from data sources to data consumers, including BI dashboards and ML models.

As our Data Quality Engineer, you are an extremely detail oriented, out-of-the-box problem solver with a commitment to doing high-quality work. You will work with the Engineering, Product and Customer Success teams to support the flow of cleaned, quality data to ultimately drive customer success.

How You Will Make an Impact:

  • Identify metrics used to measure data quality
  • Establish data validations that cover both functional and domain-specific KPI data
  • Monitor data quality metrics and perform root cause analysis of data quality issues, taking appropriate steps to address any issues
  • Make sure that data quality processes are integrated into the data architecture
  • Support all the data governance initiatives
  • Understand the data and KPI reporting requirements for clients, ensuring that the data quality initiatives align

Skills and Qualifications : (even if you do not meet these skills 100%, we still welcome you to apply)

  • BSc or MSc Degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or related field
  • 3+ years’ experience in data engineering and quality assessment roles
  • Proficiency with Python and SQL
  • Bonus if experienced with DBT
  • A strong understanding of data management concepts including data profiling and mapping
  • Skilled in performing data quality assessments to identify data inconsistencies, inaccuracies and incompleteness in data products
  • Strong analytical skills to identify patterns, trends in data and data quality issues
  • Good understanding of data governance concepts including data privacy and security
  • A mindset of continuous improvement, identifying areas for improvement within the data quality process and workflows
  • Ability to troubleshoot and solve data quality issues, including identifying the root cause of problems and implementing effective solutions
  • Above bar communication skills, both written and oral, to interface in a collaborative team environment
  • Well organized individual that pays close attention to detail
  • Able to effectively prioritize in a fast-paced and fast-changing environment
  • Bonus if you have experience integrating with large retail e-commerce sites

About Us:

Bold Metrics, established in 2017, is a SaaS solution for retailers and brands to reduce returns, improve sustainability and supercharge their supply chain from the ground up. Using a comprehensive set of machine learning and AI technologies to accurately capture customer body measurements, we help apparel brands unlock the power of body data to meet the demands of today's increasingly personalized world.

We strive to create a place to work where we all feel safe, empowered, engaged and inspired. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to offering employment that is based upon personal capabilities and qualifications without discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Global GTM Operations Team

At TRACTIAN, the GTM Operations team is a global department that supports Tractian GTM teams across the US, Brazil, and Mexico. We are a foundational team that is building the systems and processes that support our GTM, Product, and Operations teams and directly impact our customer experience.

What you will do:

As a BI Analyst, you will work daily with HubSpot, Metabase, and BigQuery to ensure the extraction and analysis of reliable data. Your primary focus will be assisting the GTM Ops team in optimizing efficiency across sales, marketing, and customer success while improving observability and automation across multiple functions. This role requires an energetic and proactive individual who can provide both technical and strategic support to drive business success.

Responsibilities

  • Be a Data Wizard: Engage with key stakeholders to understand their analytical needs and translate them into actionable data backed insights.
  • Develop and maintain data-driven dashboards and reports to provide visibility into key performance indicators (KPIs) and business trends.
  • Specific areas of focus will include: sales and customer success analytics, compensation calculations for the GTM team, management of conversational analytics platform, managing customer contract data (pricing proposals and purchase orders).
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses of business processes and objectives, implementing new metrics that enhance strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Proactively introduce new ideas and develop creative, engaging data visualizations to facilitate insight accessibility and enhance decision-making.
  • Manage and improve all business intelligence processes, ensuring efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience writing and optimizing SQL queries.
  • 2+ years of professional experience in a data-intensive role, such as business intelligence, data analytics, or a similar field.

  • Hands-on experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, Data Studio, Metabase, or similar platforms.
  • Experience working with cloud-based data warehouses like BigQuery.
  • Proficiency in Python or other programming languages for data analysis and automation.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with a proactive and ownership-driven mindset.
  • Aligns with our mission and values of Tractian.

Compensation:

  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses.

  • Education and courses stipend.
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years.

  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation.

Join to apply for the Software Engineer, Product role at Brex .

Why join us
Brex is the AI-powered spend platform. We help companies spend with confidence with integrated corporate cards, banking, and global payments, plus intuitive software for travel and expenses. Tens of thousands of companies from startups to enterprises — including DoorDash, Flexport, and Compass — use Brex to proactively control spend, reduce costs, and increase efficiency on a global scale.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex
The Engineering team includes Data, IT, Security, and Software, and is responsible for building innovative products and infrastructure for both internal and external users. We have multiple autonomous and collaborative teams who are eager to learn, teach, and constantly improve how things work. Together, we strive to build robust and scalable systems that enable Brex to grow rapidly and help our customers reach their full potential.

Where you’ll work
This role will be based in our Sao Paulo office. You must be willing to work in office at least 2 days per week on Wednesday and Thursday, starting the week of September 1st, 2025. Employees will be able to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, for a minimum of one week at a time.

What You’ll Do
We are looking for folks with an interest in building products and tools, who are comfortable dealing with a lot of moving pieces. You will be building customer-facing products that will drive direct business impact and shape our long-term technical vision with a high-quality bar. You will have the opportunity to learn and push the frontier of providing the best financial software experience to help companies grow. You will be encouraged to be metric and data-driven and to think creatively to help Brex scale and prepare for the new markets we are about to enter.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build strong, resilient, and robust APIs, libraries, and tools to power Brex engineers and operations

Requirements

Bonus points

  • Experience collaborating with experts in product, design, and operations
  • Familiarity with functional programming languages
  • Strong writing skills
  • Proactive approach

description:

O profissional atuará em conjunto com a equipes de design analógico e também fazendo interface com a implementação física digital, sendo responsável por garantir a qualidade física e elétrica dos blocos críticos do projeto.
Responsabilidades:
- Planejar e executar o layout físico de circuitos analógicos e de sinal misto, com foco em matching, simetria, roteamento crítico e minimização de ruídos/parasitas.

- Interagir com a equipe de design esquemático para garantir o correto entendimento dos requisitos de topologia e elétricos.
- Realizar verificações físicas completas (DRC, LVS) e colaborar com extração de parasitas para simulações pós-layout (PEX).
- Avaliar impactos de variações de processo, ruído e acoplamento nos circuitos.
- Apoiar na definição de floorplan e integração de blocos analógicos em projetos mixed-signal.
- Otimizar o layout visando alta confiabilidade, robustez elétrica e rendimento fabril (yield).
- Documentar práticas de layout e participar ativamente das revisões de design.
- Colaborar com os times de design esquemático e design digital para discutir limitações e restrições para os circuitos por conta de sua implementação física.
- Colaborar com times de teste e caracterização na identificação de falhas relacionadas ao layout.

description:
Join to apply for the Engenheiro de Instalações role at GRUPO MONTO .

Elaborar, executar e analisar projetos de elétrica, considerando as necessidades imediatas para a realização dos trabalhos, métodos a serem aplicados, recursos necessários e outras exigências, a fim de atender às necessidades do cliente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Identificar e propor soluções que atendam às demandas da parte elétrica das obras, através de levantamentos realizados juntos aos clientes, observando dados técnicos para que suas necessidades sejam atendidas de forma adequada.
  • Buscar conciliar preço e adequação tecnológica / técnica dos serviços elétricos oferecidos pela Empresa, às exigências dos clientes, visando garantir as condições de competitividade da Empresa.
  • Garantir a realização do controle e a otimização orçamentária das propostas, quanto a sua área de atuação, assegurando a atualização e a padronização dos processos de trabalhos, bem como a definição de diretrizes e procedimentos a serem seguidos, de acordo com as estratégias estabelecidas pela Empresa, a fim de contribuir para a otimização das operações e a lucratividade desejada.
  • Assegurar a elaboração do levantamento de todos os custos diretos e indiretos dos serviços de montagem elétrica da obra, visando calcular e/ou projetar o preço dos mesmos e seu orçamento final, bem como elaborar planilha de preços, a fim de alavancar a margem de lucratividade exigida pela Empresa.
  • Estudar o processo de montagem e manutenção mecânica, avaliando as condições operacionais, definindo as variações que podem ocorrer nos materiais, mão de obra e equipamentos, repassando para as devidas áreas.
  • Observar os critérios adotados pelo cliente na avaliação da qualidade dos serviços prestados, visando estabelecer a metodologia de trabalho a ser desenvolvida.
  • Assegurar a obtenção de informações de montagens elétricas necessárias à elaboração de um orçamento seguro e competitivo, visando atender as expectativas da Empresa.
  • Interagir, permanentemente, com as áreas de engenharia, visando identificar e adequar novos serviços e tecnologias aplicáveis às necessidades, estrutura, políticas e estratégias da Empresa e do cliente.
  • Analisar os projetos elaborados pelos prestadores de serviços, avaliando dados e especificações técnicas, a fim de definir viabilidade de produção.
  • Subsidiar as áreas de Orçamento, Engenharia, Planejamento e Suprimentos, repassando informações vitais para elaboração de planejamentos, custos e materiais necessários no desenvolvimento da obra.
  • Dar suporte ao cliente, à área de compras e produção, interpretando os projetos a serem realizados, quando necessário ou solicitado.
  • Programar as etapas de trabalho para cada frente de trabalho, de forma a garantir o cumprimento do cronograma.
  • Ler, interpretar e discutir sobre plantas e projetos, objetivando o andamento da obra dentro dos padrões de tempo, recursos e qualidade desejadas.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, a critério do superior imediato.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação: Ensino Superior em Engenharia Civil (Registro Profissional no CREA), ou Técnico em instalações.
  • Planejamento, controle de processos e Métodos de montagens elétricas.
  • Normas Técnicas e legislação inerente a construção/montagens elétricas.
  • Pacote Office.

title: Controller
description:
O Controller é um profissional estratégico no ambiente corporativo, com foco na gestão financeira, contábil e de controle interno. Ele desempenha um papel essencial no planejamento, monitoramento e análise do desempenho econômico da empresa, garantindo a precisão dos dados financeiros e a tomada de decisões fundamentadas.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  1. Planejamento e controle financeiro: Elaborar e acompanhar o orçamento anual (budget) e previsões financeiras (forecast). Monitorar a execução orçamentária e propor ajustes para alinhar os resultados aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa. Desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs).
  2. Gestão de contabilidade e demonstrações financeiras: Supervisionar a contabilidade geral (terceirizada), garantindo a conformidade com normas locais e internacionais. Revisar e validar demonstrações financeiras, como balanço patrimonial, demonstração de resultados e fluxo de caixa. Realizar análises financeiras para subsidiar relatórios gerenciais.
  3. Auditoria e compliance: Coordenar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo suporte e garantindo a transparência dos processos financeiros. Implementar e monitorar controles internos para mitigar riscos financeiros e operacionais.
  4. Gestão de custos: Monitorar e analisar custos operacionais para identificar oportunidades de redução e otimização. Implementar e acompanhar sistemas de controle de custos por produto, projeto ou unidade de negócio.
  5. Suporte estratégico e decisório: Atuar como parceiro estratégico da alta gestão, fornecendo análises e recomendações financeiras. Participar no desenvolvimento de estratégias de crescimento e alocação de recursos. Avaliar viabilidade de projetos e investimentos, considerando retorno financeiro e impacto no negócio.
  6. Liderança e gestão de equipes: Liderar equipes de contabilidade, controladoria e finanças, promovendo capacitação e desenvolvimento profissional. Garantir a integração das áreas financeiras com outros departamentos da organização.

Requisitos: Ciências contábeis completo. Desejável especialização em controladoria, auditoria ou áreas afins. Experiência em rotinas contábeis, financeiras e controladoria - tributação lucro real. Inglês será um diferencial.

Horário: Segunda a Sexta - 08h às 18h. Trabalho presencial em Goiânia - GO. Setor Santa Genoveva.

Contrato CLT + benefícios (VR R$24,00 por dia trabalhado + VA R$550,00 por mês). 50% do plano de saúde, convênio odontológico e seguro de vida em grupo.

Interessados informar pretensão salarial que será analisada conforme experiência.

description:

  8. Posicionar e ajustar as matrizes (ferramentas de estampagem) e gabaritos (guias de precisão) de acordo com o tipo de peça a ser fabricada;
  9. Conferir as chapas metálicas (aço, alumínio, entre outros) quanto à qualidade e conformidade com as especificações do projeto, garantindo que o material esteja livre de defeitos que possam prejudicar a produção.

title: Consultant Engineer - Boiler and Machinery - Chemical
description:
Overview

FM is currently seeking an Engineer with process or loss prevention experience within the Chemical industry to join our South American Engineering Team. When not in the field you will work remotely out of your home office.

At FM, you have the power to influence outcomes and make a difference in the future – yours and your clients. When you join our team as Consultant Engineer, you can leverage your engineering background to help clients neutralize potential disasters — saving property and businesses. With the company’s nearly two centuries of knowledge and experience behind you, you’ll work hands on with some of the world’s most influential organizations, helping them understand risk and protect their assets.

Responsibilities

Among the attributions you will:

  • Evaluate the integrity and reliability of equipment, identify hazards and deficiencies to deliver focused risk improvement solutions and reduce equipment risk.
  • Utilize Operating standards, data sheets and guides to provide risk guidance and implement best practices.
  • Prepare engineering reports, loss expectancies to support risk improvement.
  • Collaborate with Operations Engineering, Client Services, Account Management and Underwriting on Boiler & Machinery recommendations.
  • Engineers will work from a home office, must be able to manage their time and work independently with minimal supervision.
  • This is a field-based role and will require travel to large, complex industrial client sites to evaluate the operations and systems of the site and identify risks and hazards. Expected overnight travel is from 75 to 100 nights per year
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering with a concentration in either electrical, mechanical or chemical engineering.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ work experience combined with bachelor’s degree in engineering.
  • The position is based on Sao Paulo area.
  • Experience in a high hazard industry, preferentially in Chemical industry .

description:
Conheça a nossa história!

Na Imex acreditamos que a inovação é a chave para um futuro mais saudável. Somos uma empresa inovadora, com uma forte presença no mercado de saúde e tecnologia. Com mais de 20 anos de história, somos especialistas nesse segmento e a nossa missão é transformar o setor de saúde por meio de equipamentos médicos de alta qualidade, tanto para uso humano quanto veterinário, atuando em todo o Brasil.

Aqui valorizamos o compromisso com resultados e a colaboração entre as pessoas. Valorizamos o comprometimento, a diversidade e a autenticidade de cada um, e acreditamos que quando todos crescem juntos, o impacto é ainda maior.

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Especialista Técnico em Equipamentos de Diagnóstico por Imagem , você será responsável por garantir a instalação, manutenção e suporte técnico dos nossos equipamentos de diagnóstico por imagem, garantindo a qualidade e a confiabilidade de nossos produtos no campo. Seu trabalho será essencial para o bom funcionamento dos equipamentos nos hospitais e clínicas, sempre buscando a excelência no atendimento aos nossos clientes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será o seu dia a dia?

  • Realizar instalação, calibração e manutenção preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos de diagnóstico por imagem (radiologia, ultrassonografia, tomografia, entre outros);
  • Oferecer suporte técnico remoto e presencial aos clientes, solucionando dúvidas e problemas técnicos;
  • Treinar usuários sobre a operação e manutenção dos equipamentos;
  • Diagnosticar falhas e realizar reparos de acordo com os procedimentos da empresa;
  • Acompanhar e controlar os indicadores de performance dos equipamentos, gerando relatórios técnicos para os gestores;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de vendas, engenharia e atendimento ao cliente para garantir a satisfação dos clientes;
  • Assegurar que todos os procedimentos de segurança e regulamentações técnicas sejam seguidos rigorosamente.

Requisitos e qualificações

Para fazer a sua história acontecer aqui, precisamos que você domine esses assuntos:

  • Formação técnica ou superior em áreas como Engenharia Biomédica, Engenharia Eletrônica, Física Médica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com equipamentos de diagnóstico por imagem (radiologia, ultrassonografia, tomografia, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em processos de manutenção e calibração de equipamentos médicos;
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos com agilidade e precisão;
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar;
  • CNH de categoria B;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e deslocamentos conforme demanda.

Agora, se você quiser se diferenciar, é bom você ter…

  • Conhecimento em normas regulatórias da ANVISA e demais regulamentações do setor de saúde;
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de manuais e normas internacionais;
  • Experiência prévia em empresas do segmento de equipamentos médicos ou saúde.

Informações adicionais

O que você ganha ao fazer parte da nossa história

  • Trabalhar em um ambiente inovador e com grande potencial de crescimento profissional;
  • Possibilidade de atuação remota ou em diversos pontos do Brasil, com flexibilidade de horários;
  • Participação em programas de capacitação e treinamentos contínuos;
  • Excelente oportunidade de desenvolvimento de carreira no setor de saúde e tecnologia.

Região de atuação?

Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia e saúde, deseja fazer a diferença em um setor inovador e em crescimento, cadastre-se e venha fazer parte da nossa história!

O que te espera no dia a dia:

Um SAP Funcional SD é consultor com experiência (Sales and Distribution), que tem um conhecimento mais profundo dos processos de vendas e distribuição e já adquiriu experiência prática em projetos SAP. Esse profissional tem autonomia para realizar configurações complexas, solucionar problemas e colaborar diretamente com os stakeholders na implementação de soluções para os processos de negócio. Ele também desempenha um papel mais proativo no desenvolvimento de projetos e no suporte às operações de vendas e distribuição.

Esse profissional já está em uma posição de assumir maior responsabilidade em projetos e ajudar a liderar equipes menores, sendo um elo importante entre o negócio e a tecnologia.

  • Participação em rollouts e implementações de novos módulos SD em diferentes filiais ou regiões, ajustando configurações conforme os requisitos locais.

É diferencial:

title: Registered Respiratory Therapist
description:
Good Shepherd Rehabilitation · Good Shepherd Specialty Hospital

Full Time (36+ hrs/wk), Night Shift - 12 hours, 7:00pm-7:30am

JOB SUMMARY

The respiratory therapist will perform specific duties and responsibilities as outlined. Under medical supervision, the individual must be able to adapt to the particular area of assignment and be able to perform accordingly.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  1. DELIVERS QUALITY CARE
    By integrating the elements of examination, evaluation, diagnosis, prognosis and intervention to optimize outcomes.
    By optimizing patient independence.
    By administering inhalants and aerosolized medications, performing bronchial hygiene, operating mechanical ventilators, delivering therapeutic gas administration, and by performing hyperinflation modalities per established respiratory protocols.
    Perform cardiopulmonary and hemological diagnostic studies.
  2. PROMOTES SAFE AND CLEAN WORKING ENVIRONMENT
    By complying with policies and procedures, rules and regulations governing environment of care and patient safety.
  3. DETERMINES AND/OR FACILITATES DISCHARGE/DISCONTINUATION OF SERVICES
    By analyzing achievement of anticipated goals and expected outcomes, planning discharge/discontinuation and providing appropriate home instruction, follow-up or referral.
  4. RECORDS PATIENT SERVICES
    By documenting, dating and authenticating respiratory therapy examination, evaluation, diagnosis, prognosis, intervention and outcomes in accordance with facility and regulatory guidelines.
    By billing for specific interventions provided.
  5. DEVELOPS AND ENHANCES PROFESSIONAL KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
    By participating in continuing education to maintain licensure, reviewing professional publications and providing learning experiences for professional development.
  6. CONTRIBUTES TO TEAM EFFORT
    By embracing change to achieve common goals, demonstrating willingness to provide service at other sites as necessary, investigating opportunities for new lines of services, contributing to the development of peers and promoting a positive work environment and by accomplishing related results as needed.
  7. COMPLIES WITH FEDERAL, STATE AND LOCAL LEGAL AND PROFESSIONAL REQUIREMENTS
    By understanding and adhering to current standards of practice for respiratory therapy, guide for professional conduct including the code of ethics and practice guidelines established by the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.
    By providing appropriate supervision to other healthcare professionals and coworkers.
  8. ENSURES OPERATION OF EQUIPMENT
    By completing preventive maintenance requirements, following manufacturer’s instructions, troubleshooting malfunctions, calling for repairs.
  9. PROTECTS PATIENT INFORMATION AND CONFIDENTIALITY
    By securing all information in confidential space, following facility confidentiality policy.
  10. CONTRIBUTES TO PI TEAM EFFORTS
    By assisting the Clinical Resource Specialist with data collection, monitoring, analyzing and reporting.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. A visão de longo prazo da Amazon.com é proporcionar uma experiência de compra global consistente para todos os clientes, independentemente do site, dispositivo, idioma ou cultura. Nosso objetivo é desenvolver um software que ofereça uma experiência de compra única, alinhada às preferências de cada usuário. A equipe INTech Latam da Amazon está contratando desenvolvedores de software.

Sobre a posição

Um desenvolvedor de software (SDE) na Amazon resolve desafios de negócios através da tecnologia, é responsável por seus sistemas de ponta a ponta e influencia a direção tecnológica que impacta centenas de milhões de clientes ao redor do mundo. Espera-se que projete soluções escaláveis e flexíveis, trabalhando com estruturas de dados, algoritmos e programação orientada a objetos, enfrentando desafios complexos de computação em larga escala. Você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em equipes ágeis e de rápido crescimento, colaborando com profissionais de excelência.

Sobre você

Busca uma carreira onde possa construir, entregar e impressionar. Cria recursos que atingem milhões de clientes globalmente, analisa problemas de forma holística, projeta ciclos de feedback e contribui para ecossistemas diversos.

Local de trabalho

O time INTech Latam na Amazon trabalha no Centro de Desenvolvimento de Software no Brasil, criando recursos para o site da Amazon em diferentes países e apoiando operações. Você aprenderá a projetar, implementar e testar soluções escaláveis usando a plataforma AWS em projetos ágeis.

Valorizamos a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão

Na Amazon Brasil, temos um Comitê de DEI com representantes diversos, promovendo um ambiente interno plural. Nossos grupos de afinidade (BEN, , Glamazon, Pessoa com Deficiência) apoiam e representam diferentes comunidades, atuando como embaixadores da agenda de inclusão.

Requisitos básicos

  • Entender aplicações críticas ponta a ponta e avaliar designs de alto e baixo nível.
  • Contribuir na estratégia técnica das equipes, assumindo responsabilidades por trade-offs técnicos.
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Proficiência em pelo menos uma linguagem: C, C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, Kotlin, JavaScript, Clojure.
  • Experiência com design de sistemas, programação de aplicativos, banco de dados em UNIX/Linux.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Kanban, Scrum, etc.), modelagem OO, Web Services, UNIX e bancos de dados.

Qualificações preferenciais

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou área relacionada; mestrado é um diferencial.
  • Histórico com soluções de grande escala em ambientes ambíguos.
  • Conhecimento do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software e entrega eficiente.
  • Habilidades de relacionamento com clientes e entendimento profundo de requisitos.
  • Capacidade de propor soluções técnicas alternativas e liderar esforços de engenharia.
  • Experiência na entrega de projetos grandes e multifuncionais.
  • Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Habilidades analíticas e de design comprovadas.
  • Experiência em orientar e treinar equipes de engenharia em questões técnicas complexas.

Orange Business is here!

About us

Orange Business is a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business. Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

About the role

The Presales Solution Design Support team being an integral part of the IPSE will interlock with Global Marketing, GDO, CDIO and International teams with a clear objective of streamlining the bid process, accelerate presales autonomy, simplify presales solution development and validation, and increase our win ratio. The team will continuously develop their skills in strategic domains as well as technical skills for the future to drive value to our customers. That’s why the 3 main strategy pillars for IPSE are based on;

  • Replicability through Capitalization: facilitate replicability using capitalization to optimize what has been already sold. Identify reusable solutions and ensure capitalization of repetitive proposed solutions to expand presales autonomy and support Product Management. More specifically, provide Brick and others documentation to accelerate sales autonomy
  • Improving Velocity of our solution design & validation, facilitate the Go to Market for more sales autonomy through early engagement by participating to qualification phase,
  • Bring add value expertise to the SVP, being aligned with the SVP strategy to support SVP and Innovative support integration

Job Description

The Presales Solution Design Architect will work within different squads as a pivotal link among all organizations and presales teams, committed to providing guidance, technical expertise and assistance to promote technically and commercially innovative solutions that matches customer needs.

He/She will guarantee simplified approaches leading to optimizations, facilitate new services integration and orchestration, increase the volume of available knowledge for replicability, and bring agility to the process.

Main activities

In their engagements the Presales Design Support Architect will navigate complexities and assist presales while;

  • Contributing actively to the international bid process providing support at different stages (consultancy via early engagement in qualification phase, guidance during design stage, validation and costing of non-standard elements, handover of won deals)
  • Being responsible for providing solution design expertise support to global presales teams with relevance to SVPs and domain of expertise.
  • Adopting new ways of working promoting agility and presales autonomy via replicability.
  • Engaging with Marketing and Business Development when appropriate to review strategy and solution positioning
  • Minimizing response times and ensure the quality of a solution in support of sales. Solutions are expected to be commercially competitive, while maintaining or exceeding the level of compliancy agreed within solution strategy.
  • Coordinating actions internally and externally to ensure all the solution components are implementable and operable from engineering, delivery (GDO & I2), operations, and IT standpoints.
  • Assessing associated risks of tailored solutions, providing recommendations for risks provisioning as feasible, and documenting those risks in internal risk register.
  • After the bid is signed, ensure a smooth transition of commitment and deliverables from Pre-Sales to Post-Sales and support pre-sales worldwide communities through active contribution

The Presales Design Support Architect will ensure high quality of the below deliverables;

  • Validation responses including High-Level-Design (HLD) describing how the solution can be built, and ensuring it’s interworking with existing technologies or other service blocks. The response shall be assigned a maturity level that indicates the level of autonomy for future reuse.
  • Current replicable solutions continuously enriched with design updates, new features, delivery experience and product position.
  • Jointly developed service definitions and product collaterals as part of engagements within squads and/or product team projects

The Presales Design Support Architect will keep up-to-date with emerging trends and technologies in relevant domains and provide recommendations for their adoption within orange business SVPs strategy

About you

Key Skills, Knowledge and Abilities

  • Customer, objectives and results driven
  • Solid technical skills and knowledge of relevant domain/ field of expertise inline with Evolution platform SVP (DI; Connectivity , Cloud , Security and Orchestration) .
  • Strong knowledge of Service Management and Service Integration solutions , ex: Observability , Service now .
  • Good knowledge of OB solutions, organization, tools and processes
  • Strong people networking, stakeholder management and presentation skills.
  • Experience in working with Sales, Product Managers or Factories (Engineering, Operations, Affiliates)
  • Knowledge of digital integration and API development to enable the integration of telecommunications infrastructure with other enterprise systems.
  • Autonomous and comfortable in unknown environments
  • Strong Synthetic skill
  • Leadership and matrix management
  • Changemaker by gathering knowledge and resources, proposals driver
  • Creative and innovative behavior
  • Influence, negotiation, and persuasion
  • Ability to work in a multi-cultural environment.

Qualifications, Education and Certifications

  • BSc degree in engineering or telecommunications science or equivalent
  • 10+ years of experience in telecommunications or IT industry
  • Vendor certifications in the relevant domain/ field of expertise inline with SVP.
  • High knowledge of agility and transformation management – Scrum, DevOps, SAFe certifications is a plus
  • English fluent (spoken, written)

Additional information

  • Global opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world
  • Flexible work environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working)
  • Professional development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities
  • Career growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange
  • Caring and daring culture: health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events
  • Reward programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards

Only your skills matter

COMO FUNCIONA O EXPERT MIGRATION BRAZIL
O Expert Migration Brazil oferece treinamentos a enfermeiros bacharelados para prepará-los ao reconhecimento da profissão na Alemanha.

Com o Programa da DEKRA você conta com um treinamento no idioma alemão, a fim de obter a certificação de proficiência necessária para migração e trabalho na Alemanha. Não é exigido ter o conhecimento de outros idiomas.


Aceitamos candidatura de todo o Brasil.

Strategic partner with governance teams, advocating for necessary policy updates and contributing to risk assessments.

Summary
Provides professional nursing care through skillful assessment, diagnosis, outcomes identification, planning, implementation, and evaluation in accordance with facility or department policies and procedures. Directs and manages the care of designated patients. Utilizes effective and appropriate communication styles. Assists in maintaining a safe work environment and maintains clinical and professional competency as appropriate to the population of patients served.

Job Duties

  • Assesses, plans, implements, and evaluates the care for designated patients. Recognizes the need for and initiates collaboration/communication with physicians, interdisciplinary team members, and takes actions to proactively resolve patients needs.
  • Synthesizes available data, information, and knowledge relevant to the situation to make decisions which optimize patient outcomes based on ANA Scope and Standards of Practice and the Code of Ethics.
  • Demonstrates commitment to quality and safety, in accordance with established policies and procedures, utilizing evidence-based practice. Participates in evidence-based practice and research projects as applicable.
  • Uses effective and appropriate verbal and non-verbal communication styles with patients, significant others, visitors, staff, and professional colleagues.
  • Coordinates and provides patient and family education throughout treatment course to facilitate an effective transition of care.
  • Functions as a department team member to support unit and hospital goals and objectives. Participates in all phases of the performance improvement process, including organizational and unit-based patient experience goals.
  • Performs validated technical skills based upon clinical specialty and unit practice.
  • Utilizes technology and incorporates technology to optimize alternative modes of care delivery.
  • Demonstrates leadership and team building skills including teaching and mentoring new colleagues and department interns. Additional precepting, as assigned.
  • Delegating on the basis of skills and expertise of team member, acuity and specific needs of the patient, and time availability of team members.
  • Providing input as requested for performance appraisals of care delivery team members.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Graduate of accredited Nursing program.
  • Knowledge and competence that reflects current nursing practice.
  • Ability to organize and prioritize assignments in the delivery of patient care.
  • Successful completion of additional orientation programs related to specialty.
  • Attainment and maintenance of unit-specific competencies.
  • Basic computer skills.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire.

Preferred Qualifications

Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. *Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

Qualified candidates are eligible for up to a $30,000 Sign on Bonus!

Summary
Administers all forms of respiratory care, both critical and general therapy, and directs and manages the respiratory and pulmonary care for a designated group of patients. Provides respiratory assessment, support, treatment, and diagnostic tests as part of the healthcare team.

Job Duties

  • Conducts evaluation, management and care of patients with deficiencies and abnormalities of the cardiopulmonary system.
  • Performs inventory of respiratory equipment and maintains adequate stock of equipment.
  • Provides respiratory therapy to patients as ordered by physicians according to established standards and practices.
  • Trains other staff including physicians and students in issues relevant to respiratory therapy.
  • Performs mechanical ventilator management, Bi-pap, and respiratory monitoring.
  • Performs emergency cardiopulmonary resuscitation and maintains adequate airways, measures ventilator volumes, pressures, and flows of patients requiring critical care.
  • Performs arterial blood gas studies as well as pulse oximetry, interpretation, and analysis.
  • Educates patients in collaboration in various clinical situations such as sleep apnea and CPAP machines, proper fitting of mask and headgear, and setting of pressures in concordance to sleep studio requirements.
  • Sets-up diagnostic nocturnal sleep screens.
  • Sets up, checks equipment, and administers respiratory medication for aerosol treatment as ordered by the physicians/or by patient-driven protocols, charts treatment, response, and progress.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Associate’s Degree Graduate from an RRT program accredited by the commission of accreditation for Respiratory Care.
  • Less than 1 year of experience.
  • Ability to provide respiratory therapy methodologies and techniques.
  • Ability to operate and trouble-shoot diagnostic equipment.
  • RRT - Registered Respiratory Therapist NBRC - State of Pennsylvania within 1 Year.
  • ACLS - Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 30 Days.
  • PALS - Pediatric Advanced Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days.
  • NRP - Neonatal Resuscitation Program - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days.
  • RCP - Respiratory Care Practitioner - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree Graduate from an RRT program accredited by the commission of accreditation for Respiratory Care.

Physical Demands
Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.
